        value["maxPageBytes"].is_a?(Integer) && value["maxPageBytes"].between?(1024,historical ? 16_777_216 : NEW_MAX_PAGE_BYTES) &&
        value["maxTotalAtomic"].is_a?(String) && /\A[1-9][0-9]{0,38}\z/.match?(value["maxTotalAtomic"]) &&
        value["maxTotalAtomic"].to_i <= 170_141_183_460_469_231_731_687_303_715_884_105_727,
        "RUBY_DATASET_LIMITS_INVALID")
      value
    end

    def initialize(client:, buyer:, directory:, key:, bound:, limits:, expected_snapshot: nil, original_session: nil)
      Files.need(client.is_a?(SellerClient) && buyer.is_a?(Buyer) && bound.is_a?(BoundRequest),
        "RUBY_DATASET_BUSINESS_SOURCE_REQUIRED")
      @client,@buyer,@key,@bound = client,buyer,key.dup.freeze,bound
      @dataset_id = self.class.dataset_id(key).freeze
      Files.need(bound.intent_id == @dataset_id && bound.source_sha256 == client.source.fetch("sourceSha256") &&
        bound.body.nil? && bound.describe.dig("request","method") == "GET", "RUBY_DATASET_GET_REQUEST_REQUIRED")
      @limits = self.class.normalize_limits(limits,historical: !original_session.nil?)
      Files.need(expected_snapshot.nil? || HASH.match?(expected_snapshot.to_s), "RUBY_DATASET_SNAPSHOT_INVALID")
      @expected_snapshot = expected_snapshot
      @original_session = if original_session.nil?
        nil
      else
        Files.need(original_session.is_a?(Hash) && original_session.keys.sort == %w[directory sha256] &&
          HASH.match?(original_session["sha256"].to_s), "RUBY_DATASET_ORIGINAL_SESSION_REQUIRED")
        {"directory"=>Files.directory(original_session.fetch("directory")),"sha256"=>original_session.fetch("sha256")}
      end
      @root = Files.directory(directory,create: true)
      @directory = self.class.directory_for(@root,key,create: true)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        bound.save(File.join(@directory,"request"))
        plan = Files.read(File.join(@directory,"request","request-plan.json"),262_144)
        job = {"schema"=>JOB_SCHEMA,"keySha256"=>self.class.key_id(key),"datasetId"=>@dataset_id,
          "buyerDirectory"=>buyer.directory,"sourceSha256"=>bound.source_sha256,
          "rubyManifestSha256"=>client.manifest_sha256,"requestPlanSha256"=>Files.hash(plan),
          "requestSha256"=>Files.hash(bound.record_bytes),"limits"=>@limits,
          "expectedSnapshot"=>@expected_snapshot,"originalSession"=>@original_session}
        @job_bytes = Files.json(job).freeze
        @job_sha256 = Files.hash(@job_bytes).freeze
        Files.once(File.join(@directory,"job.json"),@job_bytes)
        %w[reviews actions].each { |name| Files.directory(File.join(@directory,name),create: true) }
      end
    end

    def same_job!
      Files.need(Files.read(File.join(@directory,"job.json"),262_144) == @job_bytes, "RUBY_DATASET_JOB_CHANGED")
    end
    def complete?
      File.file?(File.join(@directory,"received.json"))
    end
    def delivery
      self.class.received(directory: @root,key: @key)
    end
    def native_call(action, arguments = {}, **options)
      @buyer.invoke("dataset."+action,@dataset_id,{"sourceSha256"=>@bound.source_sha256}.merge(arguments),**options)
    end
    private :native_call

    # The generated source and initial request are prepared offline. Creating or
    # attaching the original native session does not acquire any page.
    def prepare(cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) { same_job!; prepare_inside(cancel: cancel) }
    end
    def prepare_inside(cancel: nil)
      path = File.join(@directory,"prepared.json")
      if File.exist?(path)
        saved = Files.parse(Files.read(path,262_144))
        Files.need(saved["jobSha256"] == @job_sha256 && saved["datasetId"] == @dataset_id &&
          saved.dig("native","datasetId") == @dataset_id && HASH.match?(saved.dig("native","selectionSha256").to_s),
          "RUBY_DATASET_PREPARATION_CHANGED")
        return saved.fetch("native")
      end
      selected = @client.load_request(File.join(@directory,"request"))
      Files.need(selected.record_bytes == @bound.record_bytes, "RUBY_DATASET_REQUEST_CHANGED")
      @client.prepare(@buyer,selected,cancel: cancel)
      result = native_call("prepare",{"limits"=>@limits,"expectedSnapshot"=>@expected_snapshot,
        "originalSession"=>@original_session},cancel: cancel)
      Files.need(result.is_a?(Hash) && result["datasetId"] == @dataset_id &&
        result.dig("selection","sourceSha256") == @bound.source_sha256 &&
        HASH.match?(result["selectionSha256"].to_s), "RUBY_DATASET_PREPARATION_CHANGED")
      Files.once(path,Files.json({"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-prepared.v1",
        "jobSha256"=>@job_sha256,"datasetId"=>@dataset_id,"native"=>result}))
      result
    end
    private :prepare_inside

    def retain_review(value)
      Files.need(value.is_a?(Hash) && value["schema"] == "stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-review.v1" &&
        value["datasetId"] == @dataset_id && HASH.match?(value["reviewSha256"].to_s),
        "RUBY_DATASET_REVIEW_INVALID")
      Files.once(File.join(@directory,"reviews",value.fetch("reviewSha256")+".json"),Files.json(value))
      value
    end
    private :retain_review

    def review(cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        prepare_inside(cancel: cancel)
        retain_review(native_call("review",{},cancel: cancel))
      end
    end
    def recover(cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        return {"state"=>"RECEIVED","datasetId"=>@dataset_id,"delivery"=>delivery.manifest} if complete?
        prepare_inside(cancel: cancel)
        retain_review(native_call("recover",{},cancel: cancel))
      end
    end
    def status(cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        return {"state"=>"RECEIVED","datasetId"=>@dataset_id,"delivery"=>delivery.manifest} if complete?
        unless File.exist?(File.join(@directory,"prepared.json"))
          return {"state"=>"REQUEST_RETAINED","datasetId"=>@dataset_id}
        end
        native_call("status",{},cancel: cancel)
      end
    end

    # An explicit caller action owns this stable key. Retrying it reopens the
    # exact same call; a later continuation needs a fresh review and action key.
    # Recovery observes existing native attempts and never acquires a new page.
    def run(review:, action_key:, cancel: nil)
      action_id = self.class.key_id(action_key)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        prepared = prepare_inside(cancel: cancel)
        Files.need(review.is_a?(Hash) && HASH.match?(review["reviewSha256"].to_s) &&
          review["datasetId"] == @dataset_id && review["selectionSha256"] == prepared["selectionSha256"],
          "RUBY_DATASET_REVIEW_CHANGED")
        review_bytes = Files.read(File.join(@directory,"reviews",review.fetch("reviewSha256")+".json"),MAX_INPUT)
        Files.need(review_bytes == Files.json(review), "RUBY_DATASET_REVIEW_CHANGED")
        scope = Files.directory(File.join(@directory,"actions",action_id),create: true)
        path = File.join(scope,"request.json")
        plan = if File.exist?(path)
          Files.parse(Files.read(path,262_144))
        else
          value = {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-action.v1","jobSha256"=>@job_sha256,
            "actionKeySha256"=>action_id,"datasetId"=>@dataset_id,"reviewSha256"=>Files.hash(review_bytes),
            "callId"=>SecureRandom.uuid}
          Files.once(path,Files.json(value))
          value
        end
        Files.need(plan["schema"] == "stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-action.v1" &&
          plan["jobSha256"] == @job_sha256 && plan["actionKeySha256"] == action_id &&
          plan["datasetId"] == @dataset_id && plan["reviewSha256"] == Files.hash(review_bytes) &&
          CALL_ID.match?(plan["callId"].to_s), "RUBY_DATASET_ACTION_CHANGED")
        begin
          result = native_call("run",{"review"=>review},call_id: plan.fetch("callId"),cancel: cancel)
          retain_review(result)
          Files.once(File.join(scope,"result.json"),Files.json(result))
          result
        rescue Error => cause
          raise if cancel&.cancelled?
          observed = retain_review(native_call("recover",{},cancel: cancel))
          result = {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-action-recovery.v1",
            "outcome"=>"ORIGINAL_STATE_OBSERVED","datasetId"=>@dataset_id,
            "callId"=>plan.fetch("callId"),"originalError"=>cause.code,"review"=>observed}
          # Every recovery observation retains its own complete source result.
          Files.once(File.join(scope,"recovery-"+observed.fetch("reviewSha256")+".json"),Files.json(result))
          result
        end
      end
    end

    def receive(cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        return delivery if complete?
        prepared = prepare_inside(cancel: cancel)
        result = native_call("receive",{"directory"=>File.join(@directory,"received")},cancel: cancel)
        Files.need(result.is_a?(Hash) && result["directory"] == File.join(@directory,"received") &&
          HASH.match?(result["manifestSha256"].to_s), "RUBY_DATASET_RECEIVING_RESULT_CHANGED")
        received = DatasetDelivery.open(result.fetch("directory"),expected_manifest_sha256: result.fetch("manifestSha256"))
        Files.need(received.manifest["datasetId"] == @dataset_id && received.source_sha256 == @bound.source_sha256 &&
          received.manifest["selectionSha256"] == prepared["selectionSha256"] &&
          received.manifest["intentId"] == prepared.dig("selection","nativeSessionId"),
          "RUBY_DATASET_BUSINESS_DELIVERY_CHANGED")
        Files.once(File.join(@directory,"received.json"),Files.json({
          "schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-received.v1","jobSha256"=>@job_sha256,
          "datasetId"=>@dataset_id,"intentId"=>received.manifest["intentId"],
          "sourceSha256"=>@bound.source_sha256,"selectionSha256"=>prepared["selectionSha256"],
          "directory"=>received.directory,"manifestSha256"=>received.manifest_sha256}))
        received
      end
    end
  end
end

#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true
# MIT. Run a real seller request through its original buyer and retain the response.
require "optparse"
require_relative(File.file?(File.join(__dir__,"rails_receiving.rb")) ? "rails_receiving" : "../rails_receiving")

module Starforge
  module CustomerCommand
    module_function
    def settings(path)
      raw = Files.read(path,131_072)
      value = Files.parse(raw)
      allowed = %w[schema runtimeDirectory buyerDirectory jobsDirectory node operatorProfile workspaceDirectory timeout outputLimit responseFile]
      Files.need(value.is_a?(Hash) && (value.keys - allowed).empty? &&
        value["schema"] == "stellar-forge.ruby-customer-settings.v1" &&
        %w[runtimeDirectory buyerDirectory jobsDirectory].all? { |key| value[key].is_a?(String) && value[key].start_with?("/") },
        "RUBY_CUSTOMER_SETTINGS_REQUIRED")
      [value,raw]
    end
    def request_selection(path)
      value = Files.parse(Files.read(path))
      Files.need(value.is_a?(Hash) && (value.keys - %w[operationId inputs maxAtomic acceptIndex paymentFlow]).empty? &&
        value["operationId"].is_a?(String) && value["inputs"].is_a?(Hash) &&
        value["maxAtomic"].is_a?(String), "RUBY_CUSTOMER_REQUEST_REQUIRED")
      Files.values!(value)
    end
    def same_request!(directory,path)
      return if path.nil?
      original = request_selection(File.join(directory,"customer-request.json"))
      Files.need(original == request_selection(path), "RUBY_CUSTOMER_REQUEST_CHANGED")
    end
    def retain_request(directory,path)
      saved = File.join(directory,"customer-request.json")
      if File.exist?(saved)
        same_request!(directory,path)
        request_selection(saved)
      else
        Files.need(path, "RUBY_CUSTOMER_REQUEST_REQUIRED")
        value = request_selection(path)
        Files.once(saved,Files.json(value))
        value
      end
    end
    def request(client,selection,key)
      value = Files.parse(Files.json(selection))
      inputs = value["inputs"]
      if inputs.key?("multipart")
        part = inputs["multipart"]
        Files.need(part.is_a?(Hash) && part.keys.sort == %w[bodyBase64 contentType] &&
          part["bodyBase64"].is_a?(String), "RUBY_MULTIPART_BYTES_REQUIRED")
        bytes = Base64.strict_decode64(part["bodyBase64"])
        Files.need(Base64.strict_encode64(bytes) == part["bodyBase64"], "RUBY_MULTIPART_BYTES_REQUIRED")
        inputs["multipart"] = {"body"=>bytes,"contentType"=>part["contentType"]}
      end
      client.build_request(value["operationId"],inputs,intent_id: Receiving.intent_id(key),
        max_atomic: value["maxAtomic"],accept_index: value["acceptIndex"],payment_flow: value["paymentFlow"])
    end
    def received_result(delivery,key,package_sha)
      native = delivery.json_file("result.json")
      {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-customer-result.v1","state"=>"RECEIVED","businessKeySha256"=>Receiving.key_id(key),
        "intentId"=>delivery.manifest["intentId"],"sourceSha256"=>delivery.manifest["sourceSha256"],
        "rubyManifestSha256"=>package_sha,"directory"=>delivery.directory,"manifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256,
        "response"=>delivery.descriptor("response.bin"),"nativeStatus"=>native.dig("native","status"),
        "nativeExitCode"=>native["exitCode"],"nativeRuntimeError"=>native["runtimeError"],
        "files"=>delivery.manifest["files"]}
    end
    def main(argv)
      command = argv.shift
      values = {package: __dir__}
      parser = OptionParser.new do |options|
        options.banner = "ruby customer.rb contract|prepare|review|execute|recover|receive|status|run|reopen [options]"
        options.on("--package DIRECTORY","Complete generated Ruby seller package") { |v| values[:package] = v }
        options.on("--settings FILE","Original private host/customer settings") { |v| values[:settings] = v }
        options.on("--request FILE","Actual operation/input/atomic-limit JSON; omit to reopen the retained request") { |v| values[:request] = v }
        options.on("--key KEY","Stable application business-job key") { |v| values[:key] = v }
        options.on("--jobs-directory DIRECTORY","Original jobs root for offline reopen") { |v| values[:jobs] = v }
        options.on("--manifest-sha256 HASH","Expected original receiving manifest for offline reopen") { |v| values[:manifest] = v }
        options.on("--execute","For run only: invoke the original explicit operator execution") { values[:execute] = true }
        options.on("--help") { puts options; return 0 }
      end
      parser.parse!(argv)
      Files.need(argv.empty? && %w[contract prepare review execute recover receive status run reopen].include?(command),
        "RUBY_CUSTOMER_COMMAND_REQUIRED")
      Files.need(!values[:execute] || command == "run", "RUBY_EXECUTE_OPTION_INVALID")
      if command == "reopen"
        Files.need(values[:jobs] && values[:key], "RUBY_OFFLINE_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
        same_request!(File.join(File.expand_path(values[:jobs]),Receiving.key_id(values[:key])),values[:request])
        delivery = Receiving.received(directory: values[:jobs],key: values[:key],
          expected_manifest_sha256: values[:manifest])
        puts Files.json({"state"=>"REOPENED","intentId"=>delivery.manifest["intentId"],
          "directory"=>delivery.directory,"manifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256,
          "response"=>delivery.descriptor("response.bin")})
        return 0
      end
      if command == "contract"
        client = SellerClient.new(values[:package])
        puts Files.json({"source"=>client.source,"operations"=>client.operations,"rubyManifestSha256"=>client.manifest_sha256})
        return 0
      end
      Files.need(values[:settings] && values[:key], "RUBY_CUSTOMER_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
      selected,settings_bytes = settings(values[:settings])
      job_directory = File.join(File.expand_path(selected["jobsDirectory"]),Receiving.key_id(values[:key]))
      # A completed repeat reads only the exact original customer packet.
      if File.file?(File.join(job_directory,"received.json"))
        same_request!(job_directory,values[:request])
        Files.need(Files.read(File.join(job_directory,"customer-settings.json"),131_072) == settings_bytes,
          "RUBY_CUSTOMER_SETTINGS_CHANGED")
        delivery = Receiving.received(directory: selected["jobsDirectory"],key: values[:key],
          expected_manifest_sha256: values[:manifest])
        result = received_result(delivery,values[:key],
          Files.parse(Files.read(File.join(job_directory,"job.json"),131_072)).fetch("rubyManifestSha256"))
        if File.file?(File.join(job_directory,"customer-result.json"))
          Files.need(Files.parse(Files.read(File.join(job_directory,"customer-result.json"))) == result,
            "RUBY_CUSTOMER_RESULT_CHANGED")
        end
        Files.once(File.join(job_directory,"customer-result.json"),Files.json(result))
        puts Files.json(result)
        return 0
      end
      Files.directory(selected["jobsDirectory"],create: true)
      Files.directory(job_directory,create: true)
      selected_request = Files.lock(job_directory) do
        Files.once(File.join(job_directory,"customer-settings.json"),settings_bytes)
        retain_request(job_directory,values[:request])
      end
      client = SellerClient.new(values[:package],node: selected.fetch("node","node"))
      buyer = Buyer.new(client: client,runtime_directory: selected["runtimeDirectory"],
        state_directory: selected["buyerDirectory"],node: selected.fetch("node","node"),
        operator_profile: selected["operatorProfile"],workspace_directory: selected["workspaceDirectory"],
        timeout: selected.fetch("timeout",420),output_limit: selected.fetch("outputLimit",16_777_216))
      begin
        bound = File.file?(File.join(job_directory,"request","request-plan.json")) ?
          client.load_request(File.join(job_directory,"request")) : request(client,selected_request,values[:key])
        job = Receiving.new(client: client,buyer: buyer,directory: selected["jobsDirectory"],key: values[:key],
          bound: bound,response_file: selected["responseFile"])
        value = case command
        when "prepare"
          job.prepare
          job.status
        when "review"
          job.review
        when "execute"
          job.execute(review: job.review)
        when "recover"
          {"intentId"=>job.intent_id,"originalResult"=>job.recover}
        when "status"
          job.status
        when "receive"
          delivery = job.receive
          received_result(delivery,values[:key],client.manifest_sha256)
        when "run"
          job.prepare
          review = job.review
          original = job.recover
          original = job.execute(review: review) if original.nil? && values[:execute]
          if original && original.dig("delivery","status") == "SAVED"
            delivery = job.receive
            received_result(delivery,values[:key],client.manifest_sha256)
          else
            {"state"=>original ? "ORIGINAL_RESULT" : "REVIEW_READY","intentId"=>job.intent_id,
              "review"=>review,"originalResult"=>original}
          end
        end
        Files.once(File.join(job.directory,"customer-result.json"),Files.json(value)) if value && value["state"] == "RECEIVED"
        puts Files.json(value)
      ensure
        buyer.close
      end
      0
    end
  end
end

if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  begin
    exit Starforge::CustomerCommand.main(ARGV)
  rescue Starforge::Error => error
    warn Starforge::Files.json({"error"=>error.code,"callId"=>error.call_id,"intentId"=>error.intent_id})
    exit 2
  rescue OptionParser::ParseError, ArgumentError, SystemCallError
    warn Starforge::Files.json({"error"=>"RUBY_CUSTOMER_INPUT_OR_IO_FAILED"})
    exit 2
  end
end

#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true
# MIT. Complete dataset commissioning through the original Ruby customer package.
require "optparse"
require_relative(File.file?(File.join(__dir__,"dataset_receiving.rb")) ? "dataset_receiving" : "../dataset_receiving")
require_relative "customer"

module Starforge
  module DatasetCommand
    module_function
    def result(delivery, state = "RECEIVED")
      {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-customer-result.v1","state"=>state,
        "datasetId"=>delivery.manifest["datasetId"],"intentId"=>delivery.manifest["intentId"],
        "sourceSha256"=>delivery.source_sha256,"snapshot"=>delivery.snapshot,
        "rows"=>delivery.row_count,"fields"=>delivery.fields,"directory"=>delivery.directory,
        "manifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256,"selectionSha256"=>delivery.manifest["selectionSha256"],
        "configurationSha256"=>delivery.manifest["configurationSha256"],
        "sourceBindingSha256"=>delivery.manifest["sourceBindingSha256"],
        "nativeManifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest["nativeManifestSha256"],
        "paymentStatus"=>delivery.native_delivery["paymentStatus"],"files"=>delivery.manifest["files"]}
    end
    def options_from_file(path)
      value = Files.parse(Files.read(path,262_144))
      Files.need(value.is_a?(Hash) && (value.keys - %w[maxPages maxTotalAtomic maxRows maxPageBytes expectedSnapshot]).empty?,
        "RUBY_DATASET_LIMITS_REQUIRED")
      {"limits"=>{"maxPages"=>value.fetch("maxPages"),"maxTotalAtomic"=>value.fetch("maxTotalAtomic"),
        "maxRows"=>value.fetch("maxRows",1_000_000),"maxPageBytes"=>value.fetch("maxPageBytes",1_048_576)},
        "expectedSnapshot"=>value["expectedSnapshot"]}
    end
    def retained_options(directory, values, create: false)
      path = File.join(directory,"dataset-options.json")
      saved = File.file?(path) ? Files.parse(Files.read(path,262_144)) : nil
      Files.need(saved.nil? || saved["schema"] == "stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-customer-options.v1",
        "RUBY_DATASET_OPTIONS_CHANGED")
      selected = values[:limits] ? options_from_file(values[:limits]) :
        saved ? {"limits"=>saved.fetch("limits"),"expectedSnapshot"=>saved["expectedSnapshot"]} : nil
      Files.need(selected, "RUBY_DATASET_LIMITS_REQUIRED")
      original = if values[:session] || values[:session_sha]
        Files.need(values[:session] && HASH.match?(values[:session_sha].to_s), "RUBY_DATASET_ORIGINAL_SESSION_REQUIRED")
        {"directory"=>File.expand_path(values[:session]),"sha256"=>values[:session_sha]}
      else
        saved && saved["originalSession"]
      end
      DatasetReceiving.normalize_limits(selected.fetch("limits"),historical: !original.nil?)
      current = {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-customer-options.v1",**selected,"originalSession"=>original}
      Files.need(saved.nil? || saved == current, "RUBY_DATASET_OPTIONS_CHANGED")
      Files.once(path,Files.json(current)) if saved.nil? && create
      Files.need(saved || create, "RUBY_DATASET_RETAINED_OPTIONS_REQUIRED")
      current
    end
    def same_review!(directory, path, dataset_id, selection_sha)
      return if path.nil?
      bytes = Files.read(path,MAX_INPUT)
      value = Files.parse(bytes)
      Files.need(value.is_a?(Hash) && value["datasetId"] == dataset_id &&
        value["selectionSha256"] == selection_sha && HASH.match?(value["reviewSha256"].to_s),
        "RUBY_DATASET_REVIEW_CHANGED")
      retained = Files.read(File.join(directory,"reviews",value.fetch("reviewSha256")+".json"),MAX_INPUT)
      Files.need(Files.json(value) == retained, "RUBY_DATASET_REVIEW_CHANGED")
      value
    end
    def emit(value, destination = nil)
      raw = Files.json(value)
      if destination
        path = File.expand_path(destination)
        Files.directory(File.dirname(path))
        Files.once(path,raw)
      end
      $stdout.write(raw)
    end
    def main(argv)
      command = argv.shift
      values = {package: File.file?(File.join(__dir__,"ruby-client.json")) ? __dir__ : File.expand_path("..",__dir__),
        offset: 0, limit: 20}
      parser = OptionParser.new do |o|
        o.banner = "ruby dataset_customer.rb prepare|review|run|recover|receive|status|reopen|inspect|rows|copy [options]"
        o.on("--package DIRECTORY","Complete generated Ruby seller package") { |v| values[:package] = v }
        o.on("--settings FILE","Existing ruby-customer-settings.v1 host settings") { |v| values[:settings] = v }
        o.on("--request FILE","Original operationId/inputs/maxAtomic selection; omit on reopen") { |v| values[:request] = v }
        o.on("--limits FILE","Whole dataset limits: new maxPages<=4096, maxPageBytes<=2097152; optional expectedSnapshot") { |v| values[:limits] = v }
        o.on("--key KEY","Stable dataset business key") { |v| values[:key] = v }
        o.on("--original-session DIRECTORY","Attach an existing original SF88 acquisition") { |v| values[:session] = v }
        o.on("--session-sha256 HASH","Exact original session.json digest for attachment") { |v| values[:session_sha] = v }
        o.on("--review FILE","Exact retained original review for an explicit run") { |v| values[:review] = v }
        o.on("--action-key KEY","Stable application action key for this explicit run") { |v| values[:action_key] = v }
        o.on("--jobs-directory DIRECTORY","Existing jobs root for offline business receipt reopen") { |v| values[:jobs] = v }

      end
      parser.parse!(argv)

        "RUBY_DATASET_EXPLICIT_RUN_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
      Files.need(command == "rows" || values[:offset] == 0 && values[:limit] == 20, "RUBY_DATASET_ROW_OPTIONS_INVALID")
      if %w[inspect rows copy].include?(command)
        Files.need(values[:directory] && HASH.match?(values[:manifest].to_s), "RUBY_DATASET_OFFLINE_PACKET_REQUIRED")
        Files.need(!values[:settings] && !values[:request] && !values[:limits] && !values[:session] && !values[:review],

        delivery = DatasetDelivery.open(values[:directory],expected_manifest_sha256: values[:manifest])

            values[:limit].between?(1,1000), "RUBY_DATASET_ROW_RANGE_INVALID")
          count = 0
          delivery.each_record do |record|
            next if record["ordinal"] < values[:offset]
            break if count >= values[:limit]
            $stdout.write(record.fetch("raw_json"))
            $stdout.write("\n")
            count += 1
          end
        elsif command == "copy"
          Files.need(values[:out], "RUBY_DATASET_COPY_DESTINATION_REQUIRED")
          emit(result(delivery.copy_to(values[:out]),"COPIED"))
        else
          emit(result(delivery,"REOPENED"),values[:out])
        end
        return 0
      end
      if command == "reopen"
        Files.need(values[:jobs] && values[:key] && !values[:settings], "RUBY_DATASET_OFFLINE_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
        directory = DatasetReceiving.directory_for(values[:jobs],values[:key])
        CustomerCommand.same_request!(directory,values[:request])
        retained_options(directory,values)
        delivery = DatasetReceiving.received(directory: values[:jobs],key: values[:key],expected_manifest_sha256: values[:manifest])
        same_review!(directory,values[:review],delivery.manifest["datasetId"],delivery.manifest["selectionSha256"])
        emit(result(delivery,"REOPENED"),values[:out])
        return 0
      end
      Files.need(values[:settings] && values[:key] && !values[:directory] && !values[:jobs],
        "RUBY_DATASET_CUSTOMER_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
      settings, settings_bytes = CustomerCommand.settings(values[:settings])
      Files.need(settings["responseFile"].nil?, "RUBY_DATASET_NATIVE_OUTPUT_OPTIONS_REQUIRED")
      directory = File.join(File.expand_path(settings.fetch("jobsDirectory")),"datasets",DatasetReceiving.key_id(values[:key]))
      if File.file?(File.join(directory,"received.json"))
        CustomerCommand.same_request!(directory,values[:request])
        retained_options(directory,values)
        Files.need(Files.read(File.join(directory,"customer-settings.json"),131_072) == settings_bytes,
          "RUBY_CUSTOMER_SETTINGS_CHANGED")
        delivery = DatasetReceiving.received(directory: settings["jobsDirectory"],key: values[:key],
          expected_manifest_sha256: values[:manifest])
        same_review!(directory,values[:review],delivery.manifest["datasetId"],delivery.manifest["selectionSha256"])
        value = result(delivery)
        Files.once(File.join(directory,"dataset-result.json"),Files.json(value))
        emit(value,values[:out])
        return 0
      end
      directory = DatasetReceiving.directory_for(settings["jobsDirectory"],values[:key],create: true)
      selected_request, selected_options = Files.lock(directory) do
        Files.once(File.join(directory,"customer-settings.json"),settings_bytes)
        [CustomerCommand.retain_request(directory,values[:request]),retained_options(directory,values,create: true)]
      end
      client = SellerClient.new(values[:package],node: settings.fetch("node","node"))
      buyer = Buyer.new(client: client,runtime_directory: settings.fetch("runtimeDirectory"),
        state_directory: settings.fetch("buyerDirectory"),node: settings.fetch("node","node"),
        operator_profile: settings["operatorProfile"],workspace_directory: settings["workspaceDirectory"],
        timeout: settings.fetch("timeout",420),output_limit: settings.fetch("outputLimit",16_777_216))
      cancel = Cancellation.new
      old_int, old_term = Signal.trap("INT") { Thread.new { cancel.cancel } },Signal.trap("TERM") { Thread.new { cancel.cancel } }
      begin
        bound = if File.file?(File.join(directory,"request","request-plan.json"))
          client.load_request(File.join(directory,"request"))
        else
          client.build_request(selected_request.fetch("operationId"),selected_request.fetch("inputs"),
            intent_id: DatasetReceiving.dataset_id(values[:key]),max_atomic: selected_request.fetch("maxAtomic"),
            accept_index: selected_request["acceptIndex"],payment_flow: selected_request["paymentFlow"])
        end
        job = DatasetReceiving.new(client: client,buyer: buyer,directory: settings["jobsDirectory"],key: values[:key],
          bound: bound,limits: selected_options.fetch("limits"),expected_snapshot: selected_options["expectedSnapshot"],
          original_session: selected_options["originalSession"])
        value = case command
        when "prepare" then job.prepare(cancel: cancel)
        when "review" then job.review(cancel: cancel)
        when "status" then job.status(cancel: cancel)
        when "recover" then job.recover(cancel: cancel)
        when "run"
          review = Files.parse(Files.read(values.fetch(:review),MAX_INPUT))
          job.run(review: review,action_key: values.fetch(:action_key),cancel: cancel)
        when "receive"
          result(job.receive(cancel: cancel))
        end
        Files.once(File.join(directory,"dataset-result.json"),Files.json(value)) if value && value["state"] == "RECEIVED"
        emit(value,values[:out])
        value && value["outcome"] == "ORIGINAL_STATE_OBSERVED" ? 3 : 0
      ensure
        buyer.close
        Signal.trap("INT",old_int)
        Signal.trap("TERM",old_term)
      end
    end
  end
end

if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  begin
    exit Starforge::DatasetCommand.main(ARGV)
  rescue Starforge::Error => error
    warn Starforge::Files.json({"error"=>error.code,"callId"=>error.call_id,"intentId"=>error.intent_id})
    exit 2
  rescue OptionParser::ParseError, KeyError, ArgumentError, SystemCallError

    exit 2
  end
end

#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true
# MIT. Continue one ACTUAL existing dataset acquisition through the Ruby customer.
require_relative(File.file?(File.join(__dir__,"dataset_customer.rb")) ? "dataset_customer" : "../dataset_customer")

module Starforge
  module DatasetLifecycle
    module_function
    def received_rows(delivery)
      hash = Digest::SHA256.new
      types = delivery.fields.to_h { |name| [name,{}] }
      count = 0
      delivery.each_record do |record|
        Files.need(record["ordinal"] == count && Files.hash(record.fetch("raw_json").b) == record["sha256"],
          "RUBY_DATASET_ORIGINAL_ROW_CHANGED")
        hash.update(record.fetch("raw_json").b)
        hash.update("\n".b)
        record.fetch("values").each do |name,value|
          kind = value.nil? ? "null" : value == true || value == false ? "boolean" :
            value.is_a?(BigDecimal) ? "decimal" : value.is_a?(Integer) ? "integer" : "string"
          types.fetch(name)[kind] = types.fetch(name).fetch(kind,0) + 1
        end
        count += 1
      end
      Files.need(count == delivery.row_count && hash.hexdigest == delivery.descriptor("dataset.jsonl")["sha256"],
        "RUBY_DATASET_NATIVE_ROWS_CHANGED")
      {"rows"=>count,"fields"=>delivery.fields,"originalJsonlSha256"=>hash.hexdigest,"nativeTypes"=>types}
    end
    def reopen(output)
      root = Files.directory(output)
      original = Files.parse(Files.read(File.join(root,"dataset-lifecycle-result.json"),MAX_INPUT))
      Files.need(original["schema"] == "stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-lifecycle.v1", "RUBY_DATASET_LIFECYCLE_RESULT_CHANGED")
      delivered = original.fetch("customer")
      source = DatasetDelivery.open(delivered.fetch("directory"),expected_manifest_sha256: delivered.fetch("manifestSha256"))
      recipient = DatasetDelivery.open(File.join(root,"recipient"),expected_manifest_sha256: delivered.fetch("manifestSha256"))
      Files.need(source.manifest == recipient.manifest && received_rows(source) == original.fetch("rows") &&
        received_rows(recipient) == original.fetch("rows"), "RUBY_DATASET_RECIPIENT_CHANGED")
      {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-lifecycle-reopen.v1","status"=>"REOPENED",
        "datasetId"=>source.manifest["datasetId"],"snapshot"=>source.snapshot,"rows"=>source.row_count,
        "manifestSha256"=>source.manifest_sha256,"originalResult"=>File.join(root,"dataset-lifecycle-result.json"),
        "customerDirectory"=>source.directory,"recipientDirectory"=>recipient.directory}
    end
    def main(argv)
      command = argv.shift
      values = {}
      parser = OptionParser.new do |o|
        o.banner = "ruby examples/dataset_lifecycle.rb run --package DIR --settings FILE --request FILE --key KEY --session DIR --session-sha256 HASH --out DIR\nruby examples/dataset_lifecycle.rb reopen --out DIR"
        o.on("--package DIRECTORY") { |v| values[:package] = v }
        o.on("--settings FILE") { |v| values[:settings] = v }
        o.on("--request FILE") { |v| values[:request] = v }
        o.on("--key KEY") { |v| values[:key] = v }
        o.on("--session DIRECTORY") { |v| values[:session] = v }
        o.on("--session-sha256 HASH") { |v| values[:session_sha] = v }
        o.on("--out DIRECTORY") { |v| values[:out] = v }
        o.on("--help") { puts o; return 0 }
      end
      parser.parse!(argv)
      Files.need(argv.empty? && %w[run reopen].include?(command) && values[:out], "RUBY_DATASET_LIFECYCLE_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
      if command == "reopen"
        Files.need(values.keys == [:out], "RUBY_DATASET_LIFECYCLE_REOPEN_OPTIONS_INVALID")
        $stdout.write(Files.json(reopen(values[:out])))
        return 0
      end
      Files.need(%i[package settings request key session session_sha].all? { |key| values[key] } &&
        HASH.match?(values[:session_sha].to_s), "RUBY_DATASET_ORIGINAL_LIFECYCLE_SOURCE_REQUIRED")
      output = Files.directory(values.fetch(:out),create: true)
      settings,settings_bytes = CustomerCommand.settings(values.fetch(:settings))
      Files.need(settings["responseFile"].nil?, "RUBY_DATASET_NATIVE_OUTPUT_OPTIONS_REQUIRED")
      selected = CustomerCommand.request_selection(values.fetch(:request))
      plan = {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-lifecycle-plan.v1",
        "package"=>File.realpath(values.fetch(:package)),"settingsSha256"=>Files.hash(settings_bytes),
        "request"=>selected,"keySha256"=>DatasetReceiving.key_id(values.fetch(:key)),
        "session"=>File.expand_path(values.fetch(:session)),"sessionSha256"=>values.fetch(:session_sha)}
      Files.once(File.join(output,"lifecycle-plan.json"),Files.json(plan))
      if File.file?(File.join(output,"dataset-lifecycle-result.json"))
        $stdout.write(Files.json(reopen(output)))
        return 0
      end
      source_raw = Files.read(File.join(plan.fetch("session"),"session.json"),262_144)
      Files.need(Files.hash(source_raw) == plan["sessionSha256"], "RUBY_DATASET_ORIGINAL_DEFINITION_CHANGED")
      definition = Files.parse(source_raw)
      Files.need(definition["schema"] == "stellar-forge.sf88.dataset-session.v1" &&
        definition["directory"] == plan["session"], "RUBY_DATASET_ORIGINAL_SESSION_REQUIRED")
      client = SellerClient.new(values.fetch(:package),node: settings.fetch("node","node"))
      Files.need(client.dataset_available?, "RUBY_DATASET_PACKAGE_REQUIRED")
      buyer = Buyer.new(client: client,runtime_directory: settings.fetch("runtimeDirectory"),
        state_directory: settings.fetch("buyerDirectory"),node: settings.fetch("node","node"),
        operator_profile: settings["operatorProfile"],workspace_directory: settings["workspaceDirectory"],
        timeout: settings.fetch("timeout",420),output_limit: settings.fetch("outputLimit",16_777_216))
      begin
        bound = client.build_request(selected.fetch("operationId"),selected.fetch("inputs"),
          intent_id: DatasetReceiving.dataset_id(values.fetch(:key)),max_atomic: selected.fetch("maxAtomic"),
          accept_index: selected["acceptIndex"],payment_flow: selected["paymentFlow"])
        job = DatasetReceiving.new(client: client,buyer: buyer,directory: settings.fetch("jobsDirectory"),
          key: values.fetch(:key),bound: bound,limits: definition.fetch("limits"),
          expected_snapshot: definition["expectedSnapshot"],
          original_session: {"directory"=>plan.fetch("session"),"sha256"=>plan.fetch("sessionSha256")})
        prepared = job.prepare
        Files.once(File.join(output,"prepared.json"),Files.json(prepared))
        original = job.recover
        Files.need(original.dig("native","status") == "COMPLETE" ||
          original["state"] == "RECEIVED", "RUBY_DATASET_ORIGINAL_COMPLETED_ACQUISITION_REQUIRED")
        delivered = job.receive
        rows = received_rows(delivered)
        recipient = delivered.copy_to(File.join(output,"recipient"))
        Files.need(received_rows(recipient) == rows && recipient.manifest_sha256 == delivered.manifest_sha256,
          "RUBY_DATASET_RECIPIENT_CHANGED")
        result = {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-lifecycle.v1","status"=>"COMPLETED",
          "ruby"=>RUBY_DESCRIPTION,"rubyManifestSha256"=>client.manifest_sha256,
          "originalSession"=>{"directory"=>plan["session"],"sha256"=>plan["sessionSha256"],
            "sessionId"=>definition.dig("config","operation","intentId"),"configurationSha256"=>definition["configurationSha256"]},
          "prepared"=>prepared,"customer"=>DatasetCommand.result(delivered),"rows"=>rows,
          "recipientDirectory"=>recipient.directory}
        Files.once(File.join(output,"dataset-lifecycle-result.json"),Files.json(result))
      ensure
        buyer.close
      end
      reopened = reopen(output)
      Files.once(File.join(output,"offline-reopen-result.json"),Files.json(reopened))
      $stdout.write(Files.json(reopened))
      0
    end
  end
end
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  begin
    exit Starforge::DatasetLifecycle.main(ARGV)
  rescue Starforge::Error => error
    warn Starforge::Files.json({"error"=>error.code,"callId"=>error.call_id,"intentId"=>error.intent_id})
    exit 2
  rescue OptionParser::ParseError,KeyError,ArgumentError,SystemCallError

#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true
# MIT. Receive and use a complete original finalized SF100 room.
require "optparse"
require_relative(File.file?(File.join(__dir__,"native_dataset_receiving.rb")) ?
  "native_dataset_receiving" : "../native_dataset_receiving")

module Starforge
  module NativeDatasetCommand
    module_function
    def open_delivery(options)
      if options[:directory]
        Files.need(!options[:delivery] && !options[:manifest], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_ONE_SELECTION")
        NativeDatasetReceiving.received(directory: options[:directory])
      else
        Files.need(options[:delivery] && options[:manifest], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_DELIVERY_REQUIRED")
        delivery = DatasetDelivery.open(options[:delivery],expected_manifest_sha256: options[:manifest])
        Files.need(delivery.is_a?(NativeDatasetDelivery), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_DELIVERY_REQUIRED")
        delivery
      end
    end

    def summary(delivery)
      {"schema"=>NativeDatasetReceiving::RESULT_SCHEMA,"state"=>"RECEIVED",
        "directory"=>delivery.directory,"manifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256,
        "sourceFormat"=>delivery.source_format,"sourceId"=>delivery.source_sha256,
        "datasetId"=>delivery.manifest["datasetId"],"sourceKey"=>delivery.manifest["sourceKey"],
        "snapshot"=>delivery.snapshot,"rowCount"=>delivery.row_count,"fields"=>delivery.fields,
        "membership"=>delivery.membership,"nativeSourceBindingSha256"=>delivery.manifest["sourceBindingSha256"],
        "nativeReceiptSha256"=>delivery.descriptor("native-receiving.json")["sha256"],
        "columns"=>delivery.native_receipt["columns"],
        "semantics"=>delivery.native_manifest["semantics"],"files"=>delivery.manifest["files"]}
    end

    def export_file(delivery, name, path)
      expected = delivery.descriptor(name)
      path = File.expand_path(path)
      parent = Files.directory(File.dirname(path))
      Files.need(path != File.join(delivery.directory,name), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_EXPORT_DESTINATION_REQUIRED")
      temp = Tempfile.new([".native-dataset-export-", ".pending"],parent)
      begin
        temp.binmode
        delivery.each_chunk(name) { |bytes| temp.write(bytes) }
        temp.flush
        temp.fsync
        temp.close
        begin
          File.link(temp.path,path)
          Files.sync(parent)
        rescue Errno::EEXIST
          DatasetDelivery.snapshot_file(path,expected) { |_snapshot| }
        end
        {"path"=>path,"name"=>name,"bytes"=>expected["bytes"],"sha256"=>expected["sha256"],
          "manifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256}
      ensure
        temp.close!
      end
    end

    def main(argv)
      command = argv.shift
      options = {}
      parser = OptionParser.new do |o|
        o.banner = "ruby native_dataset_customer.rb COMMAND [options]"
        o.separator "receive --directory DIR --room ORIGINAL_ROOM --source-key KEY --dataset-id ID --native-manifest-sha256 SHA --checkout SOURCE --python ABS --node ABS"
        o.separator "resume|status --directory ORIGINAL_RECEIVING"
        o.separator "inspect|rows|copy|file --directory ORIGINAL_RECEIVING"
        o.separator "inspect|rows|copy|file --delivery COMPLETE_PACKET --manifest-sha256 SHA"
        o.separator "copy adds --out DIRECTORY; file adds --file ORIGINAL_NAME --out NEW_FILE"
        o.on("--directory DIRECTORY") { |v| options[:directory] = v }
        o.on("--room DIRECTORY") { |v| options[:room] = v }
        o.on("--source-key KEY") { |v| options[:source_key] = v }
        o.on("--dataset-id ID") { |v| options[:dataset_id] = v }
        o.on("--native-manifest-sha256 SHA") { |v| options[:native_manifest] = v }
        o.on("--checkout DIRECTORY") { |v| options[:checkout] = v }
        o.on("--python ABSOLUTE_PATH") { |v| options[:python] = v }
        o.on("--node ABSOLUTE_PATH") { |v| options[:node] = v }
        o.on("--delivery DIRECTORY") { |v| options[:delivery] = v }
        o.on("--manifest-sha256 SHA") { |v| options[:manifest] = v }
        o.on("--file NAME") { |v| options[:file] = v }
        o.on("--out PATH") { |v| options[:out] = v }
        o.on("--timeout SECONDS",Integer) { |v| options[:timeout] = v }
        o.on("-h","--help") { puts o; return 0 }
      end
      if command.nil? || %w[-h --help].include?(command)
        puts parser
        return 0
      end
      parser.parse!(argv)
      Files.need(argv.empty? && %w[receive resume status inspect rows copy file].include?(command),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMMAND_INVALID")
      selection_keys = %i[directory delivery manifest]
      allowed = case command
      when "receive" then %i[directory room source_key dataset_id native_manifest checkout python node timeout]
      when "resume" then %i[directory timeout]
      when "status" then [:directory]
      when "inspect","rows" then selection_keys
      when "copy" then selection_keys+[:out]
      when "file" then selection_keys+%i[file out]
      end
      Files.need((options.keys-allowed).empty?, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMMAND_OPTIONS_INVALID")
      interrupted = false
      cancellation = Object.new
      cancellation.define_singleton_method(:cancelled?) { interrupted }
      old_int = Signal.trap("INT") { interrupted = true }
      old_term = Signal.trap("TERM") { interrupted = true }
      begin
        result = case command
        when "receive"
          required = %i[directory room source_key dataset_id native_manifest checkout python node]
          Files.need(required.all? { |key| options[key] }, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
          receiver = NativeDatasetReceiving.new(directory: options[:directory],room: options[:room],
            source_key: options[:source_key],dataset_id: options[:dataset_id],
            expected_native_manifest_sha256: options[:native_manifest],checkout: options[:checkout],
            python: options[:python],node: options[:node])
          summary(receiver.receive(cancel: cancellation,timeout: options.fetch(:timeout,1800)))
        when "resume"
          Files.need(options[:directory], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
          summary(NativeDatasetReceiving.resume(directory: options[:directory],
            cancel: cancellation,timeout: options.fetch(:timeout,1800)))
        when "status"
          Files.need(options[:directory], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
          NativeDatasetReceiving.status(directory: options[:directory])
        else
          delivery = open_delivery(options)
          case command
          when "inspect" then summary(delivery)
          when "rows"
            $stdout.binmode
            delivery.each_chunk("dataset.jsonl") { |bytes| $stdout.write(bytes) }
            return 0
          when "copy"
            Files.need(options[:out], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_EXPORT_DESTINATION_REQUIRED")
            summary(delivery.copy_to(options[:out]))
          when "file"
            Files.need(options[:file] && options[:out], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_EXPORT_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
            export_file(delivery,options[:file],options[:out])
          end
        end
        $stdout.write(Files.json(result))
        0
      ensure
        Signal.trap("INT",old_int)
        Signal.trap("TERM",old_term)
      end
    rescue Error, OptionParser::ParseError, SystemCallError => error
      code = error.respond_to?(:code) ? error.code : error.is_a?(OptionParser::ParseError) ?
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMMAND_INVALID" : "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_FILE_UNAVAILABLE"
      $stderr.write(JSON.generate({"error"=>code})+"\n")
      2
    end
  end
end
exit Starforge::NativeDatasetCommand.main(ARGV.dup) if File.expand_path($PROGRAM_NAME) == File.expand_path(__FILE__)

#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true
# MIT. Commission the complete original finalized dataset in a customer Rails
# data layer, export every preview/receipt row, and reopen its recipient offline.
require "optparse"
require_relative "../native_dataset_receiving"
require_relative "rails_dataset/models"
require_relative "rails_dataset/create_dataset_import_tables"

module Starforge
  module NativeDatasetLifecycle
    SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-lifecycle.v1"
    APP_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-application.v1"
    APP_MANIFEST = "application-delivery.json"
    APP_FILES = %w[application.sqlite3 mapping.json selection.json receipt.json preview.json preview.csv edition.json].freeze
    DETACH_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-producer-detach.v1"
    PRODUCER_PATHS = %w[lifecycle-input.json mapping.json commit-plan.json application-commit.json outputs recipient receiving application.sqlite3].freeze
    TENANT = "native-customer"
    TABLE = "starforge_native_dataset_records"
    class SourceRow < DatasetExample::Record
      self.table_name = TABLE
    end
    module_function

    def disconnect
      ActiveRecord::Base.connection_pool.disconnect! if ActiveRecord::Base.connected?
    end

    def connect(path)
      disconnect
      ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "sqlite3",database: path,timeout: 5000)
      connection = ActiveRecord::Base.connection
      connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
      connection.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE")
      SourceRow.reset_column_information
      connection
    end

    def mapping_for(delivery, selected_keys)
      keys = selected_keys.empty? && delivery.semantics&.dig("primaryKey","complete") == true ?
        delivery.semantics.fetch("primaryKey").fetch("projected") : selected_keys
      Files.need(keys.is_a?(Array) && !keys.empty? && keys.uniq == keys &&
        keys.all? { |key| delivery.fields.include?(key) }, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_ORIGINAL_KEYS_REQUIRED")
      columns = delivery.native_receipt.fetch("columns")
      specs = columns.each_with_index.to_h do |column,index|
        name = format("value_%03d",index)
        native_type = column.fetch("type")
        type = {"string"=>"string","integer"=>"integer","number"=>"string","boolean"=>"boolean"}.fetch(native_type)
        [name,{"field"=>column.fetch("name"),"type"=>type,"null"=>"assign","missing"=>"error",
          "stringify"=>native_type == "number"}]
      end
      {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.rails-dataset-mapping.v1","columns"=>specs,
        "key_columns"=>keys.map { |key| specs.find { |_name,item| item["field"] == key }.first },
        "removal"=>{"strategy"=>"retain"}}
    end

    def initialize_database(path, delivery, mapping)
      connection = connect(path)
      names = %w[starforge_dataset_streams starforge_dataset_editions starforge_dataset_rows
        starforge_dataset_entries starforge_dataset_catalog_records]
      present = names.map { |name| connection.table_exists?(name) }
      Files.need(present.all? || present.none?, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_APPLICATION_SCHEMA_INCOMPLETE")
      unless present.all?
        connection.transaction do
          ActiveRecord::Migration.suppress_messages { CreateDatasetImportTables.new.migrate(:up) }
          connection.create_table(TABLE) do |table|
            table.string :tenant_key,null: false,limit: 128
            delivery.native_receipt.fetch("columns").each_with_index do |column,index|
              name = format("value_%03d",index)
              options = {null: column.fetch("nullable")}
              case column.fetch("type")
              when "integer" then table.bigint(name,**options)
              when "boolean" then table.boolean(name,**options)
              else table.text(name,**options)
              end
            end
            table.integer :lock_version,null: false,default: 0
            table.timestamps
          end
          connection.add_index(TABLE,["tenant_key"]+mapping.fetch("key_columns"),
            unique: true,name: "sf_native_source_key")
        end
      end
      Files.need(connection.table_exists?(TABLE), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_APPLICATION_SCHEMA_INCOMPLETE")
      SourceRow.reset_column_information
      Files.need(File.stat(path).uid == Process.uid && (File.stat(path).mode & 0077).zero?,
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRIVATE_DATABASE_REQUIRED")
    end

    def importer(delivery, source_key, mapping)
      stream = DatasetExample::DatasetStream.where(tenant_key: TENANT,name: source_key).take!
      RailsDataset.new(delivery: delivery,scope: SourceRow.where(tenant_key: TENANT),
        stream: stream,models: DatasetExample::MODELS,mapping: mapping)
    end

    def file_descriptor(path)
      File.open(path,File::RDONLY | File::NOFOLLOW | File::NONBLOCK) do |file|
        before = file.stat
        Files.need(before.file? && before.uid == Process.uid && (before.mode & 0077).zero?,
          "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRIVATE_OUTPUT_REQUIRED")
        digest,count = Digest::SHA256.new,0
        while (chunk = file.read(1_048_576))
          digest.update(chunk)
          count += chunk.bytesize
        end
        after = file.stat
        Files.need(count == before.size && [before.dev,before.ino,before.size,before.mtime,before.ctime] ==
          [after.dev,after.ino,after.size,after.mtime,after.ctime], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_OUTPUT_CHANGED")
        {"path"=>path,"bytes"=>count,"sha256"=>digest.hexdigest}
      end
    end

    def write_output(path,&block)
      DatasetExample::Artifacts.write_once(path,&block)
    end


    def descriptor_at(root, relative)
      file_descriptor(File.join(root,relative)).merge("path"=>relative)
    end

    # Verify the complete selected file while writing the unpublished output.
    # Its size may exceed the native dataset input ceiling (database/history).
    def copy_output(source_path, target_path, expected)
      write_output(target_path) do |io|
        File.open(source_path,File::RDONLY | File::NOFOLLOW | File::NONBLOCK) do |source|
          before = source.stat
          Files.need(before.file? && before.uid == Process.uid && (before.mode & 0077).zero? &&
            before.size == expected.fetch("bytes"), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRIVATE_OUTPUT_REQUIRED")
          count,digest = 0,Digest::SHA256.new
          while (chunk = source.read(1_048_576))
            count += chunk.bytesize
            Files.need(count <= expected.fetch("bytes"), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_OUTPUT_CHANGED")
            digest.update(chunk)
            written = 0
            while written < chunk.bytesize
              amount = io.write(chunk.byteslice(written,chunk.bytesize-written))
              Files.need(amount.is_a?(Integer) && amount > 0, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_OUTPUT_WRITE")
              written += amount
            end
          end
          after = source.stat
          Files.need(count == expected.fetch("bytes") && digest.hexdigest == expected.fetch("sha256") &&
            [before.dev,before.ino,before.size,before.mtime,before.ctime] ==
            [after.dev,after.ino,after.size,after.mtime,after.ctime], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_OUTPUT_CHANGED")
        end
      end
    end

    def receiving_database(recipient, expected)
      artifact = File.join(recipient,"application.sqlite3")
      working = File.join(recipient,"readback.sqlite3")
      unless File.exist?(working) || File.symlink?(working)
        copy_output(artifact,working,expected)
      end
      File.open(working,File::RDONLY | File::NOFOLLOW | File::NONBLOCK) do |file|
        stat = file.stat
        Files.need(stat.file? && stat.uid == Process.uid && (stat.mode & 0077).zero? &&
          stat.nlink == 1 && File.realpath(working) == working,
          "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRIVATE_DATABASE_REQUIRED")
      end
      connect(working)
    end

    def verify_complete_receipt(import, operation_key, expected)
      digest,count = Digest::SHA256.new,0
      sink = Object.new
      sink.define_singleton_method(:write) do |bytes|
        digest.update(bytes.b)
        count += bytes.bytesize
        bytes.bytesize
      end
      import.write_receipt(sink,operation_key: operation_key)
      Files.need(count == expected.fetch("bytes") && digest.hexdigest == expected.fetch("sha256"),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMPLETE_APPLICATION_ROWS_CHANGED")
    end

    def verify_current_targets(import, delivery)
      preview = import.preview
      begin
        summary = preview.summary
        counts = summary.fetch("counts")
        Files.need(summary.fetch("row_count") == delivery.row_count &&
          counts.fetch("unchanged") == delivery.row_count &&
          %w[inserted updated removed adopted restored source_changed].all? { |name| counts.fetch(name) == 0 } &&
          SourceRow.where(tenant_key: TENANT).count == delivery.row_count,
          "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_CURRENT_APPLICATION_ROWS_CHANGED")
        # Reading every sealed entry also verifies the complete preview stream.
        seen = 0
        preview.each_entry do |entry|
          Files.need(entry.fetch("action") == "unchanged", "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_CURRENT_APPLICATION_ROWS_CHANGED")
          seen += 1
        end
        Files.need(seen == delivery.row_count, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_CURRENT_APPLICATION_ROWS_CHANGED")
        summary
      ensure
        preview.close
      end
    end

    def row_summary(delivery)
      count,digest,types = 0,Digest::SHA256.new,delivery.fields.to_h { |name| [name,{}] }
      delivery.each_record do |record|
        digest.update(record.fetch("raw_json").b)
        digest.update("\n")
        record.fetch("values").each do |name,value|
          kind = value.nil? ? "null" : value == true || value == false ? "boolean" :
            value.is_a?(BigDecimal) ? "decimal" : value.is_a?(Integer) ? "integer" : "string"
          types.fetch(name)[kind] = types.fetch(name).fetch(kind,0)+1
        end
        count += 1
      end
      Files.need(count == delivery.row_count && digest.hexdigest == delivery.descriptor("dataset.jsonl")["sha256"],
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_ROWS_CHANGED")
      {"rows"=>count,"fields"=>delivery.fields,"jsonlSha256"=>digest.hexdigest,"types"=>types}
    end


    def application_manifest_path(root)
      File.join(root,APP_MANIFEST)
    end

    # This reader needs only the moved application folder and its selected hash.
    # Original room/runtime paths in selection.json remain provenance values.
    def read_application(root, expected_manifest_sha256:)
      root = Files.directory(root)
      Files.need(HASH.match?(expected_manifest_sha256.to_s), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_APPLICATION_HASH_REQUIRED")
      bytes = Files.read(application_manifest_path(root),4_194_304)
      Files.need(Files.hash(bytes) == expected_manifest_sha256, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_APPLICATION_CHANGED")
      manifest = Files.parse(bytes)
      Files.need(manifest["schema"] == APP_SCHEMA && manifest["dataset"].is_a?(Hash) &&
        manifest["dataset"]["directory"] == "dataset" &&
        HASH.match?(manifest["dataset"]["manifestSha256"].to_s) &&
        manifest["outputs"].is_a?(Array) && manifest["outputs"].length == APP_FILES.length &&
        manifest["outputs"].all? { |item| item.is_a?(Hash) && item["path"].is_a?(String) } &&
        manifest["outputs"].map { |item| item.fetch("path") }.sort == APP_FILES.sort,
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_APPLICATION_MANIFEST")
      outputs = manifest.fetch("outputs").to_h do |descriptor|
        name = descriptor.fetch("path")
        Files.need(descriptor.keys.sort == %w[bytes path sha256] &&
          descriptor["bytes"].is_a?(Integer) && descriptor["bytes"] >= 0 &&
          HASH.match?(descriptor["sha256"].to_s) &&
          descriptor_at(root,name) == descriptor, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_APPLICATION_FILE_CHANGED")
        [name,descriptor]
      end
      delivery = DatasetDelivery.open(File.join(root,"dataset"),
        expected_manifest_sha256: manifest.fetch("dataset").fetch("manifestSha256"))
      selected = Files.parse(Files.read(File.join(root,"selection.json"),1_048_576))
      mapping = Files.parse(Files.read(File.join(root,"mapping.json"),1_048_576))
      receipt = Files.parse(Files.read(File.join(root,"receipt.json"),16_777_216))
      Files.need(selected.is_a?(Hash) && mapping.is_a?(Hash) && receipt.is_a?(Hash) &&
        selected["source_key"] == delivery.manifest["sourceKey"] &&
        selected["dataset_id"] == delivery.manifest["datasetId"] &&
        selected["native_manifest"] == delivery.source_sha256 &&
        manifest["inputSha256"] == outputs.fetch("selection.json").fetch("sha256") &&
        manifest["sourceId"] == delivery.source_sha256 &&
        manifest["sourceKey"] == selected["source_key"] && manifest["datasetId"] == selected["dataset_id"] &&
        manifest["membership"] == delivery.membership &&
        manifest["rows"] == row_summary(delivery) &&
        manifest["receiptSha256"] == RailsDataset.sha(RailsDataset.json(receipt)) &&
        receipt["manifest_sha256"] == delivery.manifest_sha256 &&
        receipt["source_sha256"] == delivery.source_sha256,
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_APPLICATION_BINDING_CHANGED")
      {"root"=>root,"bytes"=>bytes,"manifest"=>manifest,"manifestSha256"=>expected_manifest_sha256,
        "delivery"=>delivery,"selected"=>selected,"mapping"=>mapping,"receipt"=>receipt,"outputs"=>outputs}
    end

    def receive_application(root, expected_manifest_sha256:)
      root = Files.directory(root)
      Files.lock(root) do
        package = read_application(root,expected_manifest_sha256: expected_manifest_sha256)
        selected,delivery = package.fetch("selected"),package.fetch("delivery")
        receiving_database(root,package.fetch("outputs").fetch("application.sqlite3"))
        application = importer(delivery,selected.fetch("source_key"),package.fetch("mapping"))
        received = application.receipt(operation_key: selected.fetch("dataset_id"))
        Files.need(received == package.fetch("receipt"), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_APPLICATION_RECEIPT_CHANGED")
        verify_complete_receipt(application,selected.fetch("dataset_id"),package.fetch("outputs").fetch("edition.json"))
        current = verify_current_targets(application,delivery)
        {"schema"=>APP_SCHEMA,"status"=>"APPLICATION_REOPENED","directory"=>root,
          "applicationManifestSha256"=>expected_manifest_sha256,"deliveryManifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256,
          "sourceId"=>delivery.source_sha256,"sourceKey"=>selected.fetch("source_key"),
          "datasetId"=>selected.fetch("dataset_id"),"rows"=>delivery.row_count,"revision"=>received.fetch("revision"),
          "receiptSha256"=>RailsDataset.sha(RailsDataset.json(received)),"currentTargets"=>current}
      end
    ensure
      disconnect
    end

    def publish_application(root, recipient, delivery, mapping, selected, receipt, artifacts, database_descriptor, observed)
      Files.once(File.join(recipient,"mapping.json"),Files.json(mapping))
      Files.once(File.join(recipient,"selection.json"),Files.read(File.join(root,"lifecycle-input.json"),1_048_576))
      Files.once(File.join(recipient,"receipt.json"),Files.json(receipt))
      Files.need(artifacts.map { |item| item.fetch("path") }.sort ==
        %w[outputs/edition.json outputs/preview.csv outputs/preview.json], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_APPLICATION_OUTPUT_SELECTION")
      artifacts.each do |descriptor|
        name = File.basename(descriptor.fetch("path"))
        copy_output(File.join(root,descriptor.fetch("path")),File.join(recipient,name),descriptor)
      end
      database = File.join(root,"application.sqlite3")
      copy_output(database,File.join(recipient,"application.sqlite3"),database_descriptor)
      manifest = {"schema"=>APP_SCHEMA,"inputSha256"=>Files.hash(Files.read(File.join(root,"lifecycle-input.json"),1_048_576)),
        "sourceId"=>delivery.source_sha256,"sourceKey"=>selected.fetch("source_key"),
        "datasetId"=>selected.fetch("dataset_id"),"membership"=>delivery.membership,
        "dataset"=>{"directory"=>"dataset","manifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256},
        "rows"=>row_summary(delivery),"receiptSha256"=>RailsDataset.sha(RailsDataset.json(receipt)),"runtime"=>observed,
        "outputs"=>APP_FILES.map { |name| descriptor_at(recipient,name) }}
      bytes = Files.json(manifest)
      Files.once(application_manifest_path(recipient),bytes)
      read_application(recipient,expected_manifest_sha256: Files.hash(bytes))
    end

    def copy_application(root, expected_manifest_sha256:, out:)
      root = Files.directory(root)
      out = File.expand_path(out)
      Files.need(out != root && !out.start_with?(root+File::SEPARATOR) &&
        !root.start_with?(out+File::SEPARATOR), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_APPLICATION_COPY_TARGET")
      package = read_application(root,expected_manifest_sha256: expected_manifest_sha256)
      out = Files.directory(out,create: true)
      Files.lock(out) do
        if File.exist?(application_manifest_path(out))
          read_application(out,expected_manifest_sha256: expected_manifest_sha256)
          return {"schema"=>APP_SCHEMA,"status"=>"APPLICATION_COPIED","directory"=>out,
            "applicationManifestSha256"=>expected_manifest_sha256}
        end
        Files.once(File.join(out,"application-copy.json"),
          Files.json({"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-application-copy.v1",
            "manifestSha256"=>expected_manifest_sha256}))
        copied = package.fetch("delivery").copy_to(File.join(out,"dataset"))
        Files.need(copied.manifest_sha256 == package.fetch("delivery").manifest_sha256,
          "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_APPLICATION_COPY_CHANGED")
        package.fetch("outputs").each do |name,descriptor|
          copy_output(File.join(root,name),File.join(out,name),descriptor)
        end
        Files.need(Files.read(application_manifest_path(root),4_194_304) == package.fetch("bytes"),
          "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_APPLICATION_CHANGED")
        Files.once(application_manifest_path(out),package.fetch("bytes"))
        read_application(out,expected_manifest_sha256: expected_manifest_sha256)
        {"schema"=>APP_SCHEMA,"status"=>"APPLICATION_COPIED","directory"=>out,
          "applicationManifestSha256"=>expected_manifest_sha256}
      end
    end

    def present?(path)
      File.exist?(path) || File.symlink?(path)
    end

    # A process interruption may leave our own producer paths parked here.
    # Restore the exact selected paths before any run/reopen selection is made.
    def restore_producer(root)
      staging = File.join(root,"producer-retained")
      return unless present?(staging)
      Files.directory(staging)
      marker = File.join(staging,"detach.json")
      unless File.exist?(marker)
        Files.need(Dir.children(staging).empty?, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_RESTORE_SELECTION")
        Dir.rmdir(staging)
        Files.sync(root)
        return
      end
      state = Files.parse(Files.read(marker,1_048_576))
      Files.need(state["schema"] == DETACH_SCHEMA && state["paths"] == PRODUCER_PATHS &&
        HASH.match?(state["inputSha256"].to_s), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_RESTORE_SELECTION")
      original_input = File.join(root,"lifecycle-input.json")
      input_path = present?(original_input) ? original_input : File.join(staging,"lifecycle-input.json")
      Files.need(Files.hash(Files.read(input_path,1_048_576)) == state.fetch("inputSha256"),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_RESTORE_SELECTION")
      PRODUCER_PATHS.each do |name|
        parked,original = File.join(staging,name),File.join(root,name)
        if present?(parked)
          Files.need(!present?(original), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_RESTORE_CONFLICT")
          File.rename(parked,original)
          Files.sync(staging)
          Files.sync(root)
        else
          Files.need(present?(original), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_RESTORE_MISSING")
        end
      end
      Files.need(Dir.children(staging) == ["detach.json"], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_RESTORE_SELECTION")
      File.unlink(marker)
      Files.sync(staging)
      Dir.rmdir(staging)
      Files.sync(root)
    end

    def detached_receive(root, recipient, expected_manifest_sha256:)
      restore_producer(root)
      Files.need(PRODUCER_PATHS.all? { |name| present?(File.join(root,name)) },
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_SELECTION")
      staging = Files.directory(File.join(root,"producer-retained"),create: true)
      state = {"schema"=>DETACH_SCHEMA,"inputSha256"=>Files.hash(Files.read(File.join(root,"lifecycle-input.json"),1_048_576)),
        "paths"=>PRODUCER_PATHS}
      Files.once(File.join(staging,"detach.json"),Files.json(state))
      begin
        PRODUCER_PATHS.each do |name|
          Files.need(!present?(File.join(staging,name)), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_RESTORE_CONFLICT")
          File.rename(File.join(root,name),File.join(staging,name))
          Files.sync(root)
          Files.sync(staging)
        end
        Files.need(PRODUCER_PATHS.none? { |name| present?(File.join(root,name)) },
          "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PRODUCER_STILL_AVAILABLE")
        received = receive_application(recipient,expected_manifest_sha256: expected_manifest_sha256)
        received.merge("producerPathsUnavailable"=>true,"detachedProducerPaths"=>PRODUCER_PATHS)
      ensure
        restore_producer(root)
      end
    end

    def reopen_locked(root)
      restore_producer(root)
      selected = Files.parse(Files.read(File.join(root,"lifecycle-input.json"),1_048_576))
      result = Files.parse(Files.read(File.join(root,"native-rails-result.json"),16_777_216))
      Files.need(result["schema"] == SCHEMA && result["inputSha256"] ==
        Files.hash(Files.read(File.join(root,"lifecycle-input.json"),1_048_576)) &&
        result["recipient"] == "recipient" && result["receivedApplication"] == "received-application",
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_LIFECYCLE_CHANGED")
      expected = result.fetch("applicationManifestSha256")
      package = read_application(File.join(root,"recipient"),expected_manifest_sha256: expected)
      Files.need(package.fetch("selected") == selected &&
        package.fetch("manifest").fetch("rows") == result.fetch("rows") &&
        package.fetch("manifest").fetch("membership") == result.fetch("membership") &&
        package.fetch("receipt") == result.fetch("receipt") &&
        package.fetch("manifest").fetch("dataset").fetch("manifestSha256") == result.fetch("deliveryManifestSha256") &&
        package.fetch("manifest").fetch("outputs") == result.fetch("outputs"),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_LIFECYCLE_CHANGED")
      received = receive_application(File.join(root,"received-application"),expected_manifest_sha256: expected)
      {"schema"=>SCHEMA,"status"=>"REOPENED","directory"=>root,"result"=>"native-rails-result.json",
        "applicationManifestSha256"=>expected,"manifestSha256"=>received.fetch("deliveryManifestSha256"),
        "sourceId"=>received.fetch("sourceId"),"rows"=>received.fetch("rows"),"revision"=>received.fetch("revision"),
        "receiptSha256"=>received.fetch("receiptSha256"),"recipient"=>"received-application",
        "currentTargets"=>received.fetch("currentTargets")}
    end

    def reopen(root)
      root = Files.directory(root)
      Files.lock(root) { reopen_locked(root) }
    ensure
      disconnect
    end

    def run(selected, cancel)
      root = Files.directory(selected.fetch("out"),create: true)
      input = selected.reject { |key,_value| key == "out" }
      input_bytes = Files.json(input)
      Files.lock(root) do
        restore_producer(root)
        Files.once(File.join(root,"lifecycle-input.json"),input_bytes)
        return reopen_locked(root) if File.exist?(File.join(root,"native-rails-result.json"))
        receiving = File.join(root,"receiving")
        delivery = if File.exist?(File.join(receiving,"request.json"))
          NativeDatasetReceiving.resume(directory: receiving,cancel: cancel)
        else
          NativeDatasetReceiving.new(directory: receiving,room: selected.fetch("room"),
            source_key: selected.fetch("source_key"),dataset_id: selected.fetch("dataset_id"),
            expected_native_manifest_sha256: selected.fetch("native_manifest"),
            checkout: selected.fetch("checkout"),python: selected.fetch("python"),node: selected.fetch("node"))
            .receive(cancel: cancel)
        end
        Files.need(delivery.source_sha256 == selected.fetch("native_manifest") &&
          delivery.manifest["sourceKey"] == selected.fetch("source_key") &&
          delivery.manifest["datasetId"] == selected.fetch("dataset_id"), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_ORIGINAL_SELECTION_CHANGED")
        mapping = mapping_for(delivery,selected.fetch("keys"))
        Files.once(File.join(root,"mapping.json"),Files.json(mapping))
        recipient = Files.directory(File.join(root,"recipient"),create: true)
        delivery.copy_to(File.join(recipient,"dataset"))
        outputs = Files.directory(File.join(root,"outputs"),create: true)
        database = File.join(root,"application.sqlite3")
        phase_path = File.join(root,"application-commit.json")
        if File.exist?(phase_path)
          phase = Files.parse(Files.read(phase_path,16_777_216))
          plan_bytes = Files.read(File.join(root,"commit-plan.json"),1_048_576)
          plan = Files.parse(plan_bytes)
          Files.need(phase["schema"] == "stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-application-commit.v1" &&
            phase["inputSha256"] == Files.hash(input_bytes) &&
            phase["deliveryManifestSha256"] == delivery.manifest_sha256 &&
            phase["planSha256"] == Files.hash(plan_bytes), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMMIT_SELECTION_CHANGED")
          receipt,observed,artifacts = phase.fetch("receipt"),phase.fetch("runtime"),phase.fetch("artifacts")
          database_descriptor = phase.fetch("database")
          Files.need(database_descriptor.fetch("path") == "application.sqlite3" &&
            descriptor_at(root,"application.sqlite3") == database_descriptor,
            "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_DATABASE_COPY_CHANGED")
        else
          initialize_database(database,delivery,mapping)
          stream = DatasetExample::DatasetStream.where(tenant_key: TENANT,name: selected.fetch("source_key")).create_or_find_by!({})
          original = importer(delivery,selected.fetch("source_key"),mapping)
          commit_path = File.join(root,"commit-plan.json")
          if File.exist?(commit_path)
            plan = Files.parse(Files.read(commit_path,1_048_576))
            Files.need(plan["inputSha256"] == Files.hash(input_bytes) &&
              plan["operationKey"] == selected.fetch("dataset_id") &&
              plan["deliveryManifestSha256"] == delivery.manifest_sha256, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMMIT_SELECTION_CHANGED")
          else
            preview = original.preview
            begin
              write_output(File.join(outputs,"preview.json")) { |io| preview.write_json(io) }
              write_output(File.join(outputs,"preview.csv")) { |io| preview.write_csv(io) }
              artifacts = %w[outputs/preview.json outputs/preview.csv].map { |name| descriptor_at(root,name) }
              plan = {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-commission.v1",
                "inputSha256"=>Files.hash(input_bytes),"operationKey"=>selected.fetch("dataset_id"),
                "deliveryManifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256,"preview"=>preview.summary,"outputs"=>artifacts}
              Files.once(commit_path,Files.json(plan))
            ensure

            end

          Files.need(!cancel&.cancelled?, "RUBY_NATIVE_CANCELLED")

            "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_APPLICATION_RECEIPT_CHANGED")

          artifacts = plan.fetch("outputs") + [descriptor_at(root,"outputs/edition.json")]
          observed = {"ruby"=>RUBY_VERSION,"activeRecord"=>ActiveRecord::VERSION::STRING,
            "sqlite"=>ActiveRecord::Base.connection.select_value("SELECT sqlite_version()"),

            "sourceRows"=>SourceRow.where(tenant_key: TENANT).count}

            "planSha256"=>Files.hash(Files.read(File.join(root,"commit-plan.json"),1_048_576)),
            "receipt"=>receipt,"runtime"=>observed,"artifacts"=>artifacts,"database"=>database_descriptor}

        end
        package = publish_application(root,recipient,delivery,mapping,selected,receipt,artifacts,database_descriptor,observed)
        expected = package.fetch("manifestSha256")
        # Close over every source, mapping, metadata and output byte before the
        # independent copy. The original customer room is never renamed.
        first = receive_application(recipient,expected_manifest_sha256: expected)
        copied_root = File.join(root,"received-application")
        copy_application(recipient,expected_manifest_sha256: expected,out: copied_root)
        detached = detached_receive(root,copied_root,expected_manifest_sha256: expected)
        result = {"schema"=>SCHEMA,"status"=>"COMMITTED_AND_REOPENED",
          "inputSha256"=>Files.hash(input_bytes),"sourceId"=>delivery.source_sha256,
          "nativeReceiptSha256"=>delivery.descriptor("native-receiving.json")["sha256"],
          "nativeSourceBindingSha256"=>delivery.manifest["sourceBindingSha256"],
          "deliveryManifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256,"membership"=>delivery.membership,
          "rows"=>package.fetch("manifest").fetch("rows"),"preview"=>plan.fetch("preview"),"receipt"=>receipt,
          "runtime"=>observed,"applicationDatabase"=>"application.sqlite3",
          "applicationManifestSha256"=>expected,"applicationManifest"=>APP_MANIFEST,
          "outputs"=>package.fetch("manifest").fetch("outputs"),"recipient"=>"recipient",
          "receivedApplication"=>"received-application",
          "firstReceiving"=>first.reject { |key,_value| key == "directory" },
          "detachedReceiving"=>detached.reject { |key,_value| key == "directory" }}

        reopen_locked(root)
      end
    ensure
      disconnect
    end

    def main(argv)
      command = argv.shift
      options = {"keys"=>[]}
      parser = OptionParser.new do |o|
        o.banner = "ruby examples/native_dataset_lifecycle.rb run --out PRIVATE_DIR --room ORIGINAL_ROOM --native-manifest-sha256 SHA --source-key KEY --dataset-id ID --checkout SOURCE --python ABS --node ABS [--key ORIGINAL_FIELD]\nruby examples/native_dataset_lifecycle.rb reopen --out PRIVATE_DIR\nruby examples/native_dataset_lifecycle.rb receive --delivery APPLICATION_FOLDER --manifest-sha256 SHA\nruby examples/native_dataset_lifecycle.rb copy --delivery APPLICATION_FOLDER --manifest-sha256 SHA --out NEW_FOLDER"
        %w[out room source-key dataset-id checkout python node delivery].each do |name|
          o.on("--"+name+" VALUE") { |value| options[name.tr("-","_")] = value }
        end
        o.on("--native-manifest-sha256 SHA") { |value| options["native_manifest"] = value }
        o.on("--manifest-sha256 SHA") { |value| options["manifest"] = value }
        o.on("--key FIELD") { |value| options["keys"] << value }
        o.on("--help") { puts o; return 0 }
      end
      parser.parse!(argv)
      Files.need(argv.empty? && %w[run reopen receive copy].include?(command),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_LIFECYCLE_OPTIONS")
