        Files.need(UUID.match?(id.to_s), "DATASET_OPERATOR_REVIEW_ID")
        Files.directory(File.join(@directory,id), create: create)
      end

      def selection(id)
        value = Store.read(File.join(path(id),"selection.json"))
        Files.need(value["schema"] == "stellar-forge.dataset-operator-selection.v1" &&
          value["id"] == id && value["tenant_key"] == @tenant_key &&
          HASH.match?(value.dig("candidate","selection_sha256").to_s), "DATASET_OPERATOR_SELECTION")
        stream(value.dig("candidate","stream_id"))
        original = value.fetch("candidate").reject { |key,_| key == "selection_sha256" }
        Files.need(RailsDataset.fingerprint(original) == value["candidate"]["selection_sha256"],
          "DATASET_OPERATOR_SELECTION_CHANGED")
        value
      end

      def select(id:, candidate_id:, selection_sha256:, actor:)
        Files.need(actor.is_a?(String) && !actor.empty? && actor.bytesize <= 512,
          "DATASET_OPERATOR_ACTOR_REQUIRED")
        directory = path(id, create: true)
        Files.lock(directory) do
          original_path = File.join(directory,"selection.json")
          if Store.present?(original_path)
            saved = selection(id)
            Files.need(saved.dig("candidate","id") == candidate_id &&
              saved.dig("candidate","selection_sha256") == selection_sha256,
              "DATASET_OPERATOR_SELECTION_CHANGED")
            return saved
          end
          candidate = candidates.find { |item| item["id"] == candidate_id }
          Files.need(candidate && candidate["selection_sha256"] == selection_sha256,
            "DATASET_OPERATOR_CANDIDATE_CHANGED")
          saved = {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.dataset-operator-selection.v1", "id"=>id,
            "tenant_key"=>@tenant_key, "actor"=>actor, "selected_at"=>Time.now.utc.iso8601(6),
            "operation_key"=>"dataset-operator/#{Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(@tenant_key)}/#{id}",
            "candidate"=>candidate}
          Files.once(original_path, Files.json(saved))
          state(id, "selected")
          saved
        end
      end

      def refresh(id, new_id:, actor:)
        Files.need(actor.is_a?(String) && !actor.empty? && actor.bytesize <= 512,
          "DATASET_OPERATOR_ACTOR_REQUIRED")
        original = selection(id)
        review(id)
        selected_delivery(id)
        candidate = RailsDataset.copy_json(original.fetch("candidate"))
        candidate.delete("selection_sha256")
        candidate["directory"] = File.join(path(id),"received")
        candidate["selection_sha256"] = RailsDataset.fingerprint(candidate)
        directory = path(new_id,create: true)
        Files.lock(directory) do
          file = File.join(directory,"selection.json")
          if Store.present?(file)
            saved = selection(new_id)
            Files.need(saved["original_review_id"] == id &&
              saved.dig("candidate","selection_sha256") == candidate["selection_sha256"],
              "DATASET_OPERATOR_SELECTION_CHANGED")
            return saved
          end
          saved = {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.dataset-operator-selection.v1","id"=>new_id,
            "tenant_key"=>@tenant_key,"actor"=>actor,"selected_at"=>Time.now.utc.iso8601(6),
            "original_review_id"=>id,
            "operation_key"=>"dataset-operator/#{Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(@tenant_key)}/#{new_id}",
            "candidate"=>candidate}
          Files.once(file,Files.json(saved))
          state(new_id,"selected")
          saved
        end
      end

      def state(id, phase = nil, details = {})
        file = File.join(path(id),"state.json")
        if phase
          value = {"phase"=>phase, "updated_at"=>Time.now.utc.iso8601(6)}.merge(details)
          Store.replace(file, value)
          value
        elsif Store.present?(file)
          Store.read(file)
        else
          {"phase"=>"selected"}
        end
      end

      def selected_delivery(id)
        chosen = selection(id).fetch("candidate")
        @formats.fetch(chosen.fetch("format")).call(File.join(path(id),"received"), chosen.fetch("manifest_sha256"))
      end

      def importer(id)
        chosen = selection(id).fetch("candidate")
        record = stream(chosen.fetch("stream_id"))
        package = selected_delivery(id)
        dataset = package.respond_to?(:dataset) ? package.dataset : package
        RailsDataset.new(delivery: dataset, stream: record, scope: @target_scope.call(record),
          models: @models, mapping: chosen.fetch("mapping"))
      end

      def prepare(id)
        directory = path(id)
        Files.lock(directory) do
          if Store.present?(File.join(directory,"review.json"))
            saved = review(id)
            phase = if Store.present?(File.join(directory,"committed.json"))
              "complete"
            elsif Store.present?(File.join(directory,"approval.json"))
              state(id)["phase"] == "import_error" ? "import_error" : "approved"
            else
              "ready"
            end
            state(id,phase)
            return saved
          end
          chosen = selection(id).fetch("candidate")
          state(id,"preparing")
          begin
            receiver = File.join(directory,"received")
            if Store.present?(File.join(directory,"received.json"))
              package = selected_delivery(id)
            else
              package = @formats.fetch(chosen.fetch("format")).call(chosen.fetch("directory"), chosen.fetch("manifest_sha256"))
              package.copy_to(receiver)
              package = selected_delivery(id)
              Files.once(File.join(directory,"received.json"), Files.json({
                "manifest_sha256"=>package.manifest_sha256, "format"=>chosen.fetch("format")}))
            end
            Files.need(package.manifest_sha256 == chosen.fetch("manifest_sha256"), "DATASET_OPERATOR_DELIVERY_CHANGED")
            preview = retained_preview(id)
            begin
              descriptors = []
              descriptors << Store.write(File.join(directory,"preview.json")) { |io| preview.write_json(io) }
              descriptors << Store.write(File.join(directory,"preview.csv")) { |io| preview.write_csv(io) }
              groups = GROUPS.to_h { |name| [name, {"count"=>0,"pages"=>[]}] }
              descriptors << Store.write(File.join(directory,"changes.jsonl")) do |io|
                preview.each_entry do |row|
                  GROUPS.each do |name|
                    next unless name == "all" || row["action"] == name || row[name] == true
                    group = groups.fetch(name)
                    group["pages"] << io.pos if (group["count"] % PAGE_SIZE).zero?
                    group["count"] += 1
                  end
                  io.write(RailsDataset.json(row) + "\n")
                end
              end
              descriptors << Store.write(File.join(directory,"mapping.json")) { |io| io.write(Files.json(chosen.fetch("mapping"))) }
              record = {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.dataset-operator-review.v1", "id"=>id,
                "selection_sha256"=>Files.hash(Files.read(File.join(directory,"selection.json"))),
                "prepared_at"=>Time.now.utc.iso8601(6), "summary"=>preview.summary,
                "groups"=>groups, "files"=>descriptors}
              Files.once(File.join(directory,"review.json"), Files.json(record))
              state(id,"ready")
              record
            ensure
              preview.close
            end
          rescue Exception => error
            state(id,"prepare_error", "code"=>error.respond_to?(:code) ? error.code : error.class.name,
              "message"=>error.message.to_s[0,4000])
            raise
          end
        end
      end

      # Save the complete original review before deriving any browser/export files.
      # A crash during export replays this exact preview even if targets later change.
      def retained_preview(id)
        file = File.join(path(id),"preview.bundle")
        unless Store.present?(file)
          selected = importer(id).preview
          begin
            Store.write(file) do |io|
              io.write(Files.json(selected.summary))
              selected.each_entry { |entry| io.write(RailsDataset.json(entry) + "\n") }
            end
          ensure
            selected.close
          end
        end
        reopened = nil
        File.open(file, File::RDONLY | File::NOFOLLOW | File::NONBLOCK) do |io|
          before = io.stat
          Files.need(before.file?, "DATASET_OPERATOR_PREVIEW_CHANGED")
          header = Files.parse(io.gets.to_s)
          reopened = RailsDataset::Preview.new(header.fetch("binding"))
          io.each_line { |line| reopened.append(Files.parse(line)) }
          reopened.seal
          after = io.stat
          Files.need(reopened.summary == header &&
            [before.dev,before.ino,before.size,before.mtime,before.ctime] ==
            [after.dev,after.ino,after.size,after.mtime,after.ctime], "DATASET_OPERATOR_PREVIEW_CHANGED")
          current = importer(id).binding
          %w[stream_id target_model scope_sha256 source mapping mapping_sha256 schema_sha256].each do |key|
            Files.need(header.fetch("binding").fetch(key) == current.fetch(key),
              "DATASET_OPERATOR_REVIEW_INPUT_CHANGED")
          end
        end
        reopened
      rescue Exception
        reopened&.close
        raise
      end

      def review(id)
        directory = path(id)
        selection(id)
        record = Store.read(File.join(directory,"review.json"))
        Files.need(record["schema"] == "stellar-forge.dataset-operator-review.v1" && record["id"] == id &&
          record["selection_sha256"] == Files.hash(Files.read(File.join(directory,"selection.json"))),
          "DATASET_OPERATOR_REVIEW_CHANGED")
        summary = record.fetch("summary")
        Files.need(summary["preview_sha256"] == RailsDataset.fingerprint({
          "schema"=>summary["schema"], "binding"=>summary["binding"], "counts"=>summary["counts"],
          "row_count"=>summary["row_count"], "entries_sha256"=>summary["entries_sha256"]}),
          "DATASET_OPERATOR_PREVIEW_CHANGED")
        record
      end

      def changes(id, group: "all", page: 0)
        Files.need(GROUPS.include?(group) && page.is_a?(Integer) && page >= 0, "DATASET_OPERATOR_PAGE")
        record = review(id)
        index = record.fetch("groups").fetch(group)
        pages = [1,(index.fetch("count") + PAGE_SIZE - 1) / PAGE_SIZE].max
        Files.need(page < pages, "DATASET_OPERATOR_PAGE")
        selected = record.fetch("files").find { |file| file["name"] == "changes.jsonl" }
        rows = []
        Store.snapshot(File.join(path(id),"changes.jsonl"),selected) do |io|
          offset = index.fetch("pages")[page]
          if offset
            io.seek(offset)
            while rows.length < PAGE_SIZE && (line = io.gets)
              row = Files.parse(line)
              rows << row if group == "all" || row["action"] == group || row[group] == true
            end
          end
        end
        {"rows"=>rows, "page"=>page, "pages"=>pages, "total"=>index.fetch("count"), "group"=>group}
      end

      def approve(id, preview_sha256:, actor:)
        directory = path(id)
        Files.lock(directory) do
          value = review(id)
          Files.need(value.dig("summary","preview_sha256") == preview_sha256 &&
            actor.is_a?(String) && !actor.empty? && actor.bytesize <= 512, "DATASET_OPERATOR_APPROVAL")
          file = File.join(directory,"approval.json")
          if Store.present?(file)
            approved = Store.read(file)
            Files.need(approved["preview_sha256"] == preview_sha256, "DATASET_OPERATOR_APPROVAL_CHANGED")
          else
            approved = {"preview_sha256"=>preview_sha256, "actor"=>actor, "approved_at"=>Time.now.utc.iso8601(6)}
            Files.once(file,Files.json(approved))
          end
          state(id,"approved") unless Store.present?(File.join(directory,"committed.json"))
          approved
        end
      end

      def commit(id)
        directory = path(id)
        Files.lock(directory) do
          ready = review(id)
          approved = Store.read(File.join(directory,"approval.json"))
          Files.need(approved["preview_sha256"] == ready.dig("summary","preview_sha256"),
            "DATASET_OPERATOR_APPROVAL_CHANGED")
          original = selection(id)
          state(id,"importing")
          begin
            value = importer(id)
            receipt = value.import!(operation_key: original.fetch("operation_key"),
              expected_preview_sha256: approved.fetch("preview_sha256"))
            # A retry after the database commit uses the same original operation.
            # A complete receipt export is retained before publishing completion.
            descriptor = Store.write(File.join(directory,"receipt.json")) do |io|
              value.write_receipt(io, operation_key: original.fetch("operation_key"))
            end
            completed = {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.dataset-operator-commit.v1", "id"=>id,
              "receipt"=>receipt, "file"=>descriptor}
            Files.once(File.join(directory,"committed.json"), Files.json(completed))
            state(id,"complete")
            completed
          rescue Exception => error
            state(id,"import_error", "code"=>error.respond_to?(:code) ? error.code : error.class.name,
              "message"=>error.message.to_s[0,4000])
            raise
          end
        end
      end

      def detail(id)
        directory = path(id)
        chosen = selection(id)
        ready = Store.present?(File.join(directory,"review.json")) ? review(id) : nil
        committed = Store.present?(File.join(directory,"committed.json")) ? Store.read(File.join(directory,"committed.json")) : nil
        if committed
          original_receipt = importer(id).receipt(operation_key: chosen.fetch("operation_key"))
          Files.need(committed["receipt"] == original_receipt, "DATASET_OPERATOR_COMMIT_CHANGED")
        end
        {"selection"=>chosen, "state"=>state(id), "review"=>ready, "committed"=>committed,
          "approved"=>Store.present?(File.join(directory,"approval.json"))}
      end

      def list(before: nil, limit: 30)
        Files.need(limit.is_a?(Integer) && limit.between?(1,100), "DATASET_OPERATOR_PAGE")
        names = Dir.children(@directory).select { |id| UUID.match?(id) }
        values = names.filter_map do |id|
          next unless Store.present?(File.join(path(id),"selection.json"))
          selected = selection(id)
          cursor = selected.fetch("selected_at") + "/" + id
          next if before && cursor >= before
          {"id"=>id,"cursor"=>cursor,"title"=>selected.dig("candidate","title"),
            "selected_at"=>selected["selected_at"],"actor"=>selected["actor"],"state"=>state(id)}
        end.sort_by { |item| item["cursor"] }.reverse
        selected = values.first(limit)
        {"items"=>selected, "next_before"=>values.length > limit ? selected.last["cursor"] : nil}
      end

      def history(id, before: nil, limit: 50)
        chosen = selection(id)
        relation = @models.fetch(:edition).where(dataset_stream_id: stream(chosen.dig("candidate","stream_id")).id)
        relation = relation.where("id < ?",Integer(before,10)) if before
        rows = relation.order(id: :desc).limit(limit + 1).to_a
        value = importer(id)
        selected = rows.first(limit).map do |edition|
          receipt = value.verified_receipt(edition)
          {"id"=>edition.id.to_s,"revision"=>edition.revision,"receipt_sha256"=>edition.receipt_sha256,
            "receipt"=>receipt}
        end
        {"items"=>selected,"next_before"=>rows.length > limit ? selected.last["id"] : nil}
      end

      def export(id, name)
        directory = path(id)
        record = review(id)
        if name == "receipt.json"
          committed = Store.read(File.join(directory,"committed.json"))
          descriptor = committed.fetch("file")
        else
          descriptor = record.fetch("files").find { |file| file["name"] == name }
        end
        Files.need(descriptor, "DATASET_OPERATOR_EXPORT")
        content_type = name.end_with?(".csv") ? "text/csv; charset=utf-8" : "application/json"
        Download.new(filename: name,content_type: content_type) do |out|
          Store.snapshot(File.join(directory,name),descriptor) { |io| IO.copy_stream(io,out) }
        end
      end

      def historical_receipt(id, edition_id)
        chosen = selection(id)
        edition = @models.fetch(:edition).where(
          dataset_stream_id: stream(chosen.dig("candidate","stream_id")).id).find(edition_id)
        receipt = importer(id).verified_receipt(edition)
        Download.new(filename: "dataset-edition-#{edition.revision}.json",content_type: "application/json") do |out|
          out.write(RailsDataset.json(receipt).delete_suffix("}") + ',"rows":[')
          first, count, digest = true, 0, Digest::SHA256.new
          @models.fetch(:entry).where(dataset_edition_id: edition.id).find_each do |entry|
            raw = entry.record_json
            Files.need(Files.hash(raw) == entry.record_sha256, "DATASET_EDITION_ROW_CHANGED")
            out.write(",") unless first
            out.write(raw)
            digest.update(raw + "\n")
            count += 1
            first = false
          end
          Files.need(count == receipt["entry_count"] && digest.hexdigest == receipt["retained_entries_sha256"],
            "DATASET_EDITION_ROWS_CHANGED")
          out.write("]}\n")
        end
      end

      # A single download carries the original received delivery, selected mapping,
      # complete review, approvals and available committed receipt. The application
      # continues to use its own source deployment and database backup workflow.
      def handoff(id)
        directory = path(id)
        result = nil
        Files.lock(directory) do
          review(id)
          files = []
          visit = lambda do |base,relative|
            Dir.children(base).sort.each do |name|
              next if name.start_with?(".")
              child, logical = File.join(base,name), (relative.empty? ? name : relative + "/" + name)
              stat = File.lstat(child)
              Files.need(!stat.symlink? && stat.uid == Process.uid && (stat.mode & 0077).zero?,
                "DATASET_OPERATOR_HANDOFF_FILE")
              if stat.directory?
                Files.directory(child)
                visit.call(child,logical)
              else
                Files.need(stat.file?, "DATASET_OPERATOR_HANDOFF_FILE")
                bytes, digest = 0, Digest::SHA256.new
                File.open(child,File::RDONLY | File::NOFOLLOW | File::NONBLOCK) do |io|
                  while (chunk = io.read(1_048_576))
                    bytes += chunk.bytesize
                    digest.update(chunk)
                  end
                end
                files << {"name"=>logical,"bytes"=>bytes,"sha256"=>digest.hexdigest}
              end
            end
          end
          visit.call(directory,"")
          manifest = {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.dataset-operator-handoff.v1","review_id"=>id,
            "tenant_key"=>@tenant_key,"files"=>files}
          result = Download.new(filename: "dataset-review-#{id}.tar",content_type: "application/x-tar") do |out|
            Gem::Package::TarWriter.new(out) do |archive|
              bytes = Files.json(manifest)
              archive.add_file_simple("handoff.json",0600,bytes.bytesize) { |io| io.write(bytes) }
              files.each do |descriptor|
                Store.snapshot(File.join(directory,descriptor["name"]),descriptor) do |input|
                  archive.add_file_simple("review/" + descriptor["name"],0600,descriptor["bytes"]) do |io|
                    IO.copy_stream(input,io)
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
        result
      end

      def attachments(id, offset: 0)
        package = selected_delivery(id)
        return {"offset"=>0,"total"=>0,"next_offset"=>nil,"files"=>[]} unless package.respond_to?(:attachment_page)
        package.attachment_page(offset: offset, limit: PAGE_SIZE)
      end

      def attachment(id, file:, record_id:, column:)
        package = selected_delivery(id)
        Files.need(package.respond_to?(:attachment), "DATASET_OPERATOR_ATTACHMENT")
        result = nil
        package.attachment(file: file,record_id: record_id,column: column) do |io,metadata|
          result = Download.new(filename: metadata.fetch("filename",File.basename(file)),
            content_type: "application/octet-stream") { |out| IO.copy_stream(io,out) }
        end
        Files.need(result, "DATASET_OPERATOR_ATTACHMENT")
        result
      end
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true
# MIT. Portable Ruby receiving of a completed original SF100 data room.
require_relative "dataset_delivery"

module Starforge
  class NativeDatasetDelivery < DatasetDelivery
    SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-delivery.v1"
    SOURCE_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-source.v1"
    SELECTION_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-selection.v1"
    RECEIPT_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.finalized-dataset-receiving.v1"
    MAX_PAGE = 2_097_152 + 4096
    MAX_PAGES = 4096
    METADATA = %w[source.json selection.json native-receiving.json].freeze
    OUTPUTS = %w[manifest.json dataset.jsonl dataset.csv review.html].freeze
    attr_reader :native_receipt

    def self.file_limit(name)
      return MAX_PAGE if /\Apages\/[0-9]{5}\.json\z/.match?(name.to_s)
      return 4096 if name == "session.json"
      return 2_097_152 if name == "semantics.json"
      return 4_194_304 if name == "manifest.json"
      return 16_777_216 if name == "native-receiving.json"
      return 1_048_576 if %w[source.json selection.json].include?(name)
      return MAX_FILE if %w[dataset.jsonl dataset.csv review.html].include?(name)
      raise Error, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_FILE_NAME_INVALID"
    end

    def self.check_descriptor(name, descriptor)
      Files.need(descriptor.is_a?(Hash) && descriptor["bytes"].is_a?(Integer) &&
        descriptor["bytes"].between?(0,file_limit(name)) && HASH.match?(descriptor["sha256"].to_s),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_FILE_DESCRIPTOR_INVALID")
      descriptor
    end

    # Provider identity is read from the original producer's dictionary schema.
    # Attribution and definition/capture hashes remain on their original edition.
    def self.provider_identity(semantics)
      return nil if semantics.nil?
      Files.need(semantics.is_a?(Hash) && semantics["source"].is_a?(Hash),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SEMANTICS_INVALID")
      original = semantics.fetch("source")
      value = case semantics["schema"]
      when "stellar-forge.ckan-semantics.v1"
        {"provider"=>"ckan","catalog_origin"=>original["catalogOrigin"],
         "package_id"=>original["packageId"],"resource_id"=>original["resourceId"]}
      when "stellar-forge.odata-semantics.v1"
        Files.need(original["provider"] == "odata4", "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
        {"provider"=>"odata4","service_url"=>original["serviceUrl"],
         "entity_container"=>original["entityContainer"],"entity_set"=>original["entitySet"]}
      when "stellar-forge.superset-semantics.v1"
        return superset_provider_identity(semantics)
      when "stellar-forge.directus-semantics.v1"
        return directus_provider_identity(semantics)
      else
        raise Error, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SEMANTICS_INVALID"
      end
      Files.need(value.values.all? { |item| item.is_a?(String) && !item.empty? &&
        item.valid_encoding? && item.bytesize <= 16_384 }, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
      value
    end

    # The producer already normalizes this URL. Retain its complete reverse-proxy
    # path and reject a different URL representation instead of silently changing
    # a saved resource's logical membership.
    def self.provider_base(value)
      Files.need(value.is_a?(String) && !value.empty? && value.valid_encoding? &&
        value.bytesize <= 16_384, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
      uri = URI.parse(value)
      Files.need(uri.is_a?(URI::HTTP) && %w[http https].include?(uri.scheme) &&
        uri.host.is_a?(String) && !uri.host.empty? && uri.userinfo.nil? &&
        uri.query.nil? && uri.fragment.nil? && uri.path.end_with?("/") &&
        uri.normalize.to_s == value, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
      value
    rescue URI::InvalidURIError
      raise Error, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED"
    end

    def self.provider_text(value)
      Files.need(value.is_a?(String) && !value.empty? && value.valid_encoding? &&
        value.bytesize <= 16_384, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
      value
    end

    def self.provider_integer(value, minimum: 0)
      Files.need(value.is_a?(Integer) && value.between?(minimum,9_007_199_254_740_991),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
      value
    end

    def self.superset_provider_identity(semantics)
      source,query = semantics.fetch("source"),semantics["query"]
      Files.need(source["provider"] == "apache-superset" && source["protocolVersion"] == "6.1" &&
        HASH.match?(source["queryContextSha256"].to_s) &&
        HASH.match?(source["principalSha256"].to_s) && query.is_a?(Hash) &&
        query["savedContextSha256"] == source["queryContextSha256"],
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
      chart_uuid = source["chartUuid"]
      provider_text(chart_uuid) unless chart_uuid.nil?
      row_limit = query["rowLimit"]
      provider_integer(row_limit) unless row_limit.nil?
      {"provider"=>"apache-superset","protocol_version"=>source["protocolVersion"],
       "server_url"=>provider_base(source["baseUrl"]),
       "chart_id"=>provider_integer(source["chartId"],minimum: 1),"chart_uuid"=>chart_uuid,
       "query_ordinal"=>provider_integer(source["queryOrdinal"]),
       "query_context_sha256"=>source["queryContextSha256"],
       "principal_sha256"=>source["principalSha256"],
       "row_limit"=>row_limit,"row_offset"=>provider_integer(query["rowOffset"])}
    end

    def self.directus_provider_identity(semantics)
      source = semantics.fetch("source")
      query,principal = source["query"],source["principal"]
      Files.need(source["provider"] == "directus" && source["protocolVersion"] == "12.5" &&
        query.is_a?(Hash) && query["fields"].is_a?(Array) && query["sort"].is_a?(Array) &&
        principal.is_a?(Hash), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
      provider_text(principal["id"])
      {"provider"=>"directus","protocol_version"=>source["protocolVersion"],
       "server_url"=>provider_base(source["baseUrl"]),
       "collection"=>provider_text(source["collection"]),
       "primary_field"=>provider_text(source["primaryField"]),
       "source_principal"=>principal,"source_query"=>query}
    end

    private_class_method :provider_base, :provider_text, :provider_integer,
      :superset_provider_identity, :directus_provider_identity

    # Validate the original receiver envelope before following any original path.
    # Every returned file must resolve to the selected room and native filename.
    def self.check_receipt(receipt, room:, manifest_sha256:)
      Files.need(receipt.is_a?(Hash) && receipt["schema"] == RECEIPT_SCHEMA &&
        receipt["sourceFormat"] == "SF100_SCAN" && receipt["session"].nil? &&
        receipt["room"] == room && receipt["sourceId"] == manifest_sha256 &&
        receipt["manifestSha256"] == manifest_sha256 &&
        HASH.match?(receipt["sourceBindingSha256"].to_s) &&
        receipt["sourceFiles"] == {} && receipt["native"].is_a?(Hash),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_RECEIPT_CHANGED")
      native = receipt.fetch("native")
      scan, status = native["originalNativeScan"],native["nativeStatus"]
      Files.need(native["schema"] == "stellar-forge.sf100.dataset-delivery.v1" &&
        native["sourceFormat"] == "SF100_SCAN" && native["directory"] == room &&
        native["sourceBindingSha256"] == receipt["sourceBindingSha256"] &&
        scan.is_a?(Hash) && scan["out"] == room && scan["finalized"] == true &&
        scan["nextCursor"].nil? && scan["count"].is_a?(Integer) &&
        scan["count"].between?(0,1_000_000) && scan["total"] == scan["count"] &&
        scan["name"].is_a?(String) && !scan["name"].empty? &&
        %w[snapshot chain queryHash].all? { |key| HASH.match?(scan[key].to_s) } &&
        scan["pages"].is_a?(Array) && scan["pages"].length.between?(1,MAX_PAGES) &&
        scan["fields"].is_a?(Array) && scan["fields"].length.between?(1,64) &&
        scan["fields"].uniq == scan["fields"] && scan["fields"].all? { |field|
          field.is_a?(String) && /\A[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,47}\z/.match?(field)
        } && status.is_a?(Hash) && status["complete"] == true && status["finalized"] == true &&
        status["pages"] == scan["pages"].length && status["rows"] == scan["count"] &&
        status["total"] == scan["total"] && status["snapshot"] == scan["snapshot"] &&
        status["lastRecordDigest"] == scan["chain"], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMPLETE_SCAN_REQUIRED")
      Files.need(receipt["columns"].is_a?(Array) &&
        receipt["columns"].map { |column| column.is_a?(Hash) && column["name"] } == scan["fields"] &&
        receipt["columns"].all? { |column|
          %w[string integer number boolean].include?(column["type"]) &&
            [true,false].include?(column["nullable"])
        }, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COLUMNS_CHANGED")
      outputs = OUTPUTS + (native["semantics"].nil? ? [] : ["semantics.json"])
      archives = ["session.json"] + Array.new(scan["pages"].length) { |index| format("pages/%05d.json",index) }
      Files.need(native["outputs"].is_a?(Hash) && native["outputs"].keys.sort == outputs.sort &&
        native["archives"].is_a?(Hash) && native["archives"].keys.sort == archives.sort &&
        receipt["archives"] == native["archives"], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_FILE_SET_CHANGED")
      (outputs + archives).each do |name|
        item = native["outputs"][name] || native["archives"][name]
        check_descriptor(name,item)
        Files.need(item["path"] == File.join(room,name), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SOURCE_PATH_CHANGED")
      end
      Files.need(native["outputs"]["manifest.json"]["sha256"] == manifest_sha256 &&
        archives.drop(1).sum { |name| native["archives"][name]["bytes"] } <= MAX_FILE,
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SOURCE_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
      [outputs,archives]
    end

    def initialize(directory, raw)
      @directory,@manifest_bytes = directory.freeze,raw.dup.freeze
      @manifest_sha256 = Files.hash(raw).freeze
      @manifest = Files.parse(raw)
      Files.need(@manifest.is_a?(Hash) && @manifest["schema"] == SCHEMA &&
        @manifest["sourceFormat"] == "SF100_SCAN" &&
        %w[datasetId sourceKey].all? { |key| INTENT.match?(@manifest[key].to_s) } &&
        %w[sourceSha256 nativeManifestSha256 sourceBindingSha256 nativeReceiptSha256
          sourceRecordSha256 selectionSha256 snapshot].all? { |key| HASH.match?(@manifest[key].to_s) } &&
        @manifest["sourceSha256"] == @manifest["nativeManifestSha256"] &&
        @manifest["rowCount"].is_a?(Integer) && @manifest["rowCount"].between?(0,1_000_000) &&
        @manifest["fields"].is_a?(Array) && @manifest["files"].is_a?(Array) &&
        @manifest["files"].length.between?(8,MAX_PAGES+10), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_MANIFEST_INVALID")
      @files = {}
      @manifest["files"].each do |file|
        Files.need(file.is_a?(Hash) && file["name"].is_a?(String) && !@files.key?(file["name"]),
          "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_FILE_DESCRIPTOR_INVALID")
        self.class.check_descriptor(file["name"],file)
        @files[file["name"]] = file
      end
      Files.need((METADATA + OUTPUTS + ["session.json"] - @files.keys).empty?,
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMPLETE_FILES_REQUIRED")
      @selection = json_file("selection.json",limit: self.class.file_limit("selection.json"))
      @source = json_file("source.json",limit: self.class.file_limit("source.json"))
      @native_receipt = json_file("native-receiving.json",limit: self.class.file_limit("native-receiving.json"))
      @native_delivery = @native_receipt["native"]
      @acquisition = nil
      @native_manifest = json_file("manifest.json",limit: self.class.file_limit("manifest.json"))
      @semantics = @files.key?("semantics.json") ? json_file("semantics.json",limit: 2_097_152) : nil
      validate_native_bindings!
      validate_original_rows!
      %w[dataset.csv review.html].each { |name| with_snapshot(name) { |_snapshot| } }
      [@manifest,@files,@selection,@source,@native_receipt,@native_delivery,
        @native_manifest,@semantics].each { |value| self.class.freeze_value(value) }
      membership
    end
    private_class_method :new

    def source_format
      "SF100_SCAN"
    end
    def membership
      @membership ||= self.class.freeze_value({
        "source_format"=>"SF100_SCAN","source_key"=>@manifest.fetch("sourceKey"),
        "dataset"=>@native_manifest.fetch("dataset").fetch("name"),
        "provider_source"=>self.class.provider_identity(@semantics),
        "query_sha256"=>@native_manifest.fetch("dataset").fetch("originalQueryHash"),
        "projected_fields"=>fields})
    end

    private
    def validate_native_bindings!
      m,s,native = @manifest,@selection,@native_manifest
      Files.need(s.is_a?(Hash) && s["schema"] == SELECTION_SCHEMA &&
        s["sourceFormat"] == "SF100_SCAN" && s["datasetId"] == m["datasetId"] &&
        s["sourceKey"] == m["sourceKey"] && s["nativeManifestSha256"] == source_sha256 &&
        s["room"].is_a?(String) && File.expand_path(s["room"]) == s["room"] &&
        descriptor("selection.json")["sha256"] == m["selectionSha256"] &&
        descriptor("source.json")["sha256"] == m["sourceRecordSha256"] &&
        descriptor("native-receiving.json")["sha256"] == m["nativeReceiptSha256"],
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SELECTION_CHANGED")
      outputs,archives = self.class.check_receipt(@native_receipt,
        room: s["room"],manifest_sha256: source_sha256)
      Files.need(@files.keys.sort == (outputs+archives+METADATA).sort &&
        @native_receipt["sourceBindingSha256"] == m["sourceBindingSha256"],
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMPLETE_FILES_REQUIRED")
      (outputs+archives).each do |name|
        original = @native_delivery["outputs"][name] || @native_delivery["archives"][name]
        Files.need(%w[bytes sha256].all? { |key| original[key] == descriptor(name)[key] },
          "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_ORIGINAL_FILE_CHANGED")
      end
      scan = @native_delivery.fetch("originalNativeScan")
      dataset = native.is_a?(Hash) && native["dataset"]
      Files.need(native.is_a?(Hash) && native["schema"] == "stellar-forge.buyer-delivery-manifest.v1" &&
        dataset.is_a?(Hash) && dataset["name"] == scan["name"] &&
        dataset["rows"] == row_count && row_count == scan["count"] &&
        dataset["snapshot"] == snapshot && snapshot == scan["snapshot"] &&
        dataset["projectedFields"] == fields && fields == scan["fields"] &&
        dataset["filters"] == scan["filters"] && dataset["ranges"] == scan["ranges"] &&
        dataset["order"] == (scan["order"] || "csv-record-order") &&
        dataset["originalQueryHash"] == scan["queryHash"] && HASH.match?(dataset["originalQueryHash"].to_s) &&
        dataset["originalQuerySignature"] == scan["pages"][0]["signature"] &&
        native["chainDigest"] == scan["chain"] &&
        native["paymentStatus"] == @native_delivery["paymentStatus"] &&
        native["sourcePages"].is_a?(Array) && native["sourcePages"].length == scan["pages"].length &&
        descriptor("manifest.json")["sha256"] == source_sha256 &&
        native["outputs"].is_a?(Hash) && native["outputs"].keys.sort == (outputs-["manifest.json"]).sort,
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_ORIGINAL_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
      native["outputs"].each do |name,item|
        Files.need(item == descriptor(name).slice("bytes","sha256"), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_ORIGINAL_OUTPUT_CHANGED")
      end
      original_session = json_file("session.json",limit: 4096)
      Files.need(original_session == scan["session"] &&
        original_session["schema"] == "stellar-forge.buyer-delivery.v1",
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SESSION_CHANGED")
      if @semantics
        binding = native["semantics"]
        Files.need(binding.is_a?(Hash) && binding == @native_delivery["semantics"] &&
          binding["file"] == "semantics.json" && binding["selectedFields"] == fields &&
          binding["scope"] == "PUBLISHED_DATASET" && binding["typedRowsFile"] == "dataset.jsonl" &&
          %w[schema sha256 definitionSha256].all? { |key| binding[key] == @semantics[key] } &&
          binding["captureManifestSha256"] == @semantics.dig("source","captureManifestSha256") &&
          @semantics == scan["semanticDocument"], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SEMANTICS_CHANGED")
      else
        Files.need(native["semantics"].nil? && @native_delivery["semantics"].nil? &&
          scan["semanticDocument"].nil?, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SEMANTICS_CHANGED")
      end
      Files.need(@source.is_a?(Hash) && @source["schema"] == SOURCE_SCHEMA &&
        @source["sourceFormat"] == "SF100_SCAN" && @source["sourceKey"] == m["sourceKey"] &&
        @source["datasetId"] == m["datasetId"] && @source["originalRoom"] == s["room"] &&
        @source["sourceId"] == source_sha256 && @source["manifestSha256"] == source_sha256 &&
        @source["sourceBindingSha256"] == m["sourceBindingSha256"] &&
        @source["datasetName"] == dataset["name"] && @source["columns"] == @native_receipt["columns"] &&
        @source["providerIdentity"] == self.class.provider_identity(@semantics) &&
        @source["semanticsFile"] == (@semantics ? descriptor("semantics.json") : nil),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SOURCE_BINDING_CHANGED")
    end

    def same_typed_value?(left, right)
      return false unless left.class == right.class
      if left.is_a?(Hash)
        left.keys.sort == right.keys.sort && left.all? { |key,value| same_typed_value?(value,right[key]) }
      elsif left.is_a?(Array)
        left.length == right.length && left.zip(right).all? { |a,b| same_typed_value?(a,b) }
      else
        left == right
      end
    end

    # Reopening binds each original page record to its complete native JSONL.
    # Hash the native compact record bytes, preserving original number lexemes.
    def validate_original_rows!
      scan = @native_delivery.fetch("originalNativeScan")
      count,previous,cursor = 0,nil,nil
      intents,source_hashes = {},{}
      with_snapshot("dataset.jsonl") do |rows|
        scan["pages"].each_with_index do |page,index|
          Files.need(page.is_a?(Hash) && page["index"] == index && page["previous"] == previous &&
            page["requestCursor"] == cursor && page["returned"].is_a?(Integer) && page["returned"] >= 0 &&
            %w[chain sourceSha256 signature].all? { |key| HASH.match?(page[key].to_s) } &&
            INTENT.match?(page["intent"].to_s) && !intents[page["intent"]] && !source_hashes[page["sourceSha256"]],
            "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PAGE_CHANGED")
          Files.need(page["signature"] == scan["pages"][0]["signature"], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_QUERY_CHANGED")
          expected = {"index"=>index,"intent"=>page["intent"],"sourceSha256"=>page["sourceSha256"],
            "evidenceSha256"=>page["evidenceSha256"],"recordDigest"=>page["chain"],
            "rows"=>page["returned"],"requestedCursor"=>page["requestCursor"]}
          Files.need(@native_manifest["sourcePages"][index] == expected, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PAGE_CHANGED")
          raw = file_bytes(format("pages/%05d.json",index),limit: MAX_PAGE)
          archive = Files.parse(raw,decimals: true)
          suffix = ',"chain":"' + page["chain"] + "\"}\n"
          Files.need(raw.end_with?(suffix) &&
            Files.hash(raw.byteslice(0,raw.bytesize-suffix.bytesize) + "}") == page["chain"] &&
            archive.is_a?(Hash) && archive["schema"] == "stellar-forge.buyer-page-archive.v1" &&
            %w[schema index previous intent requestCursor sourceSha256 evidenceSha256 signature chain].all? {
              |key| archive[key] == page[key]
            }, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_ARCHIVE_CHANGED")
          payload = archive["payload"]
          Files.need(payload.is_a?(Hash) && payload["schema"] == "stellar-forge.dataset-page.v1" &&
            payload["fields"] == fields && payload.dig("dataset","snapshot") == snapshot &&
            payload.dig("dataset","name") == scan["name"] && payload["rows"].is_a?(Array) &&
            payload["rows"].length == page["returned"] &&
            payload.dig("page","returned") == page["returned"] && payload.dig("page","total") == row_count,
            "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_ARCHIVE_ROWS_CHANGED")
          columns = payload.dig("dataset","columns")
          Files.need(columns.is_a?(Array) && columns.all? { |column| column.is_a?(Hash) } &&
            fields.map { |name| columns.find { |column| column["name"] == name } } == @native_receipt["columns"] &&
            payload["semantics"] == @semantics, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PAGE_MEANING_CHANGED")
          payload["rows"].each do |original|
            line = rows.gets("\n",2_097_153)
            Files.need(line && line.end_with?("\n") && line.bytesize <= 2_097_152 &&
              same_typed_value?(Files.parse(line,decimals: true),original),
              "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_JSONL_SOURCE_CHANGED")
            count += 1
          end
          cursor = payload.dig("page","nextCursor")
          Files.need(count <= row_count && (index == scan["pages"].length-1 ? cursor.nil? : cursor.is_a?(String)),
            "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PAGE_RANGE_CHANGED")
          if cursor
            Files.need(/\A[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,512}\z/.match?(cursor), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_CURSOR_CHANGED")
            decoded = Base64.urlsafe_decode64(cursor)
            Files.need(Base64.urlsafe_encode64(decoded,padding: false) == cursor &&
              Files.parse(decoded) == {"v"=>1,"s"=>snapshot,"q"=>scan["queryHash"],"n"=>count},
              "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_CURSOR_CHANGED")
          end
          previous = page["chain"]
          intents[page["intent"]] = true
          source_hashes[page["sourceSha256"]] = true
        end
        Files.need(rows.read(1).nil? && count == row_count && cursor.nil? && previous == scan["chain"],
          "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMPLETE_ROWS_REQUIRED")
      end
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true
# MIT. Reuse the original Python SF100 scanner/receiver, then retain a complete
# portable Ruby customer edition. This operation only reads the finalized room.
require_relative "native_dataset"
require "time"

module Starforge
  class NativeDatasetReceiving
    RESULT_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-received.v1"
    PYTHON_ROOT = "stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf88-operator-buyer-cli/python"
    NATIVE_ROOT = "stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf88-operator-buyer-cli"
    ENTRY = PYTHON_ROOT + "/native-dataset-receive.py"
    attr_reader :directory

    def self.selected_request(directory)
      root = Files.directory(directory)
      bytes = Files.read(File.join(root,"request.json"),1_048_576)
      request = Files.parse(bytes)
      Files.need(request.is_a?(Hash) && request["schema"] == NativeDatasetDelivery::SELECTION_SCHEMA &&
        request["sourceFormat"] == "SF100_SCAN" &&
        [nil,"selected-absolute"].include?(request["runtimePathMode"]) &&
        %w[datasetId sourceKey].all? { |key| INTENT.match?(request[key].to_s) } &&
        HASH.match?(request["nativeManifestSha256"].to_s), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_REQUEST_INVALID")
      [root,request,bytes]
    end

    # A completed business operation opens from its own received bytes. Neither
    # the original room nor the original runtime has to remain mounted.
    def self.received(directory:, expected_manifest_sha256: nil)
      root,request,bytes = selected_request(directory)
      receipt = Files.parse(Files.read(File.join(root,"received.json"),1_048_576))
      Files.need(receipt.is_a?(Hash) && receipt["schema"] == RESULT_SCHEMA &&
        receipt["requestSha256"] == Files.hash(bytes) && receipt["datasetId"] == request["datasetId"] &&
        receipt["sourceKey"] == request["sourceKey"] && receipt["sourceId"] == request["nativeManifestSha256"] &&
        receipt["directory"] == File.join(root,"received") &&
        HASH.match?(receipt["manifestSha256"].to_s) &&
        (expected_manifest_sha256.nil? || expected_manifest_sha256 == receipt["manifestSha256"]),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_BUSINESS_RECEIPT_CHANGED")
      delivery = DatasetDelivery.open(receipt["directory"],expected_manifest_sha256: receipt["manifestSha256"])
      Files.need(delivery.is_a?(NativeDatasetDelivery) &&
        delivery.file_bytes("selection.json",limit: 1_048_576) == bytes &&
        delivery.manifest["datasetId"] == request["datasetId"] &&
        delivery.manifest["sourceKey"] == request["sourceKey"] &&
        delivery.source_sha256 == request["nativeManifestSha256"] &&
        delivery.descriptor("native-receiving.json")["sha256"] == receipt["nativeReceiptSha256"],
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_BUSINESS_DELIVERY_CHANGED")
      delivery
    end

    def self.resume(directory:, cancel: nil, timeout: 1800)
      root,request,_bytes = selected_request(directory)
      return received(directory: root) if File.exist?(File.join(root,"received.json"))
      receiver = allocate
      receiver.send(:initialize_retained,root,request,_bytes)
      receiver.receive(cancel: cancel,timeout: timeout)
    end

    def self.status(directory:)
      root,request,bytes = selected_request(directory)
      if File.exist?(File.join(root,"received.json"))
        delivery = received(directory: root)
        return {"schema"=>RESULT_SCHEMA,"state"=>"RECEIVED","directory"=>root,
          "requestSha256"=>Files.hash(bytes),"datasetId"=>request["datasetId"],"sourceKey"=>request["sourceKey"],
          "delivery"=>delivery.directory,"manifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256,
          "sourceId"=>delivery.source_sha256,"rowCount"=>delivery.row_count,"fields"=>delivery.fields,
          "membership"=>delivery.membership,"files"=>delivery.manifest["files"]}
      end
      {"schema"=>RESULT_SCHEMA,"state"=>File.exist?(File.join(root,"native-receiving.json")) ?
        "NATIVE_RECEIVED" : "PREPARED","directory"=>root,"requestSha256"=>Files.hash(bytes),
        "datasetId"=>request["datasetId"],"sourceKey"=>request["sourceKey"],
        "sourceId"=>request["nativeManifestSha256"]}
    end

    def self.executable(path)
      Files.need(path.is_a?(String) && File.absolute_path(path) == path &&
        !path.include?("\0"), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_EXECUTABLE_REQUIRED")
      real = File.realpath(path)
      Files.need(File.file?(real) && File.executable?(real), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_EXECUTABLE_REQUIRED")
      # Keep the invoked path: Python locates pyvenv.cfg before resolving this
      # symlink (PEP 405). Launching the target would lose the selected environment.
      path
    end

    def self.matches_executable?(provided, retained, legacy: false)
      return false unless provided.is_a?(String) && retained.is_a?(String) &&
        !provided.include?("\0")
      absolute = File.expand_path(provided)
      return true if absolute == retained
      legacy && File.realpath(absolute) == retained
    rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES, Errno::ENOTDIR, Errno::ELOOP
      false
    end

    # Retain the selected original source modules, not a regenerated receiver.
    # The checks bracket the read-only call. Completed packets need no runtime.
    def self.runtime_binding(checkout, python, node)
      checkout = Files.directory(checkout,private: false)
      paths = [ENTRY,"stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf100-buyer-dataset-delivery/deliver.mjs"]
      [[NATIVE_ROOT,".mjs"],[PYTHON_ROOT,".mjs"],[PYTHON_ROOT+"/stellar_forge_buyer",".py"]].each do |relative,suffix|
        root = Files.directory(File.join(checkout,relative),private: false)
        Dir.children(root).sort.each do |name|
          paths << relative+"/"+name if name.end_with?(suffix) && /\A[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*\z/.match?(name)
        end
      end
      files = paths.uniq.sort.map do |name|
        raw = Files.read(File.join(checkout,name))
        {"name"=>name,"bytes"=>raw.bytesize,"sha256"=>Files.hash(raw)}
      end
      {"directory"=>checkout,"python"=>executable(python),"node"=>executable(node),"files"=>files}
    end

    def initialize(directory:, room:, source_key:, dataset_id:, expected_native_manifest_sha256:,
      checkout:, python:, node:)
      Files.need(INTENT.match?(source_key.to_s) && INTENT.match?(dataset_id.to_s) &&
        HASH.match?(expected_native_manifest_sha256.to_s), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
      selected_directory = File.expand_path(directory)
      if File.exist?(File.join(selected_directory,"request.json"))
        root,original,raw = self.class.selected_request(selected_directory)
        Files.lock(root) do
          runtime = original["runtime"]
          legacy = original["runtimePathMode"].nil?
          Files.need(original["room"] == File.expand_path(room) &&
            original["sourceKey"] == source_key && original["datasetId"] == dataset_id &&
            original["nativeManifestSha256"] == expected_native_manifest_sha256 &&
            runtime.is_a?(Hash) && runtime["directory"] == File.expand_path(checkout) &&
            self.class.matches_executable?(python,runtime["python"],legacy: legacy) &&
            self.class.matches_executable?(node,runtime["node"],legacy: legacy) &&
            Files.read(File.join(root,"request.json"),1_048_576) == raw,
            "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_ORIGINAL_REQUEST_CHANGED")
          initialize_retained(root,original,raw)
        end
        return
      end
      @room = Files.directory(room)
      Files.directory(File.join(@room,"pages"))
      original = Files.read(File.join(@room,"manifest.json"),4_194_304)
      Files.need(Files.hash(original) == expected_native_manifest_sha256, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SOURCE_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
      @runtime = self.class.runtime_binding(checkout,python,node)
      @request = {"schema"=>NativeDatasetDelivery::SELECTION_SCHEMA,"sourceFormat"=>"SF100_SCAN",
        "sourceKey"=>source_key,"datasetId"=>dataset_id,"room"=>@room,
        "nativeManifestSha256"=>expected_native_manifest_sha256,"runtime"=>@runtime,
        "runtimePathMode"=>"selected-absolute"}
      @request_bytes = Files.json(@request).freeze
      Files.need(@request_bytes.bytesize <= 1_048_576, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_RUNTIME_SELECTION_LIMIT")
      @request_sha256 = Files.hash(@request_bytes).freeze
      @directory = Files.directory(directory,create: true)
      Files.need(@directory != @room && !@directory.start_with?(@room+File::SEPARATOR) &&
        !@room.start_with?(@directory+File::SEPARATOR), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SEPARATE_RECEIVING_DIRECTORY_REQUIRED")
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        Files.once(File.join(@directory,"request.json"),@request_bytes)
        Files.directory(File.join(@directory,"attempts"),create: true)
        Files.directory(File.join(@directory,"received"),create: true)
      end
      DatasetDelivery.freeze_value(@request)
      DatasetDelivery.freeze_value(@runtime)
    end

    def same_request!
      Files.need(Files.read(File.join(@directory,"request.json"),1_048_576) == @request_bytes,
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_REQUEST_CHANGED")
    end

    def receive(cancel: nil, timeout: 1800)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_request!
        return self.class.received(directory: @directory) if File.exist?(File.join(@directory,"received.json"))
        receipt_path = File.join(@directory,"native-receiving.json")
        unless File.exist?(receipt_path)
          Files.need(self.class.runtime_binding(@runtime["directory"],@runtime["python"],@runtime["node"]) == @runtime,
            "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_RUNTIME_CHANGED")
          Files.need(Files.hash(Files.read(File.join(@room,"manifest.json"),4_194_304)) ==
            @request["nativeManifestSha256"], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SOURCE_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
          attempt = Files.directory(File.join(@directory,"attempts",SecureRandom.uuid),create: true)
          Files.once(File.join(attempt,"attempt.json"),Files.json({"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-read.v1",
            "requestSha256"=>@request_sha256,"startedAt"=>Time.now.utc.iso8601(6)}))
          environment = {"LANG"=>"C.UTF-8","LC_ALL"=>"C.UTF-8","TZ"=>"UTC"}
          run = Runner.new(node: @runtime["python"],environment: environment).run(
            File.join(@runtime["directory"],ENTRY),
            ["--room",@room,"--node",@runtime["node"]],interpreter_arguments: ["-I","-B"],
            process_group: true,timeout: timeout,limit: 16_777_216,cancel: cancel)
          Files.once(File.join(attempt,"stdout.json"),run[:stdout])
          Files.once(File.join(attempt,"stderr.json"),run[:stderr])
          Files.once(File.join(attempt,"result.json"),Files.json({
            "schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-read-result.v1","requestSha256"=>@request_sha256,
            "exitStatus"=>run[:status].exitstatus,"termSignal"=>run[:status].termsig,"error"=>run[:error],
            "stdout"=>{"bytes"=>run[:stdout].bytesize,"sha256"=>Files.hash(run[:stdout])},
            "stderr"=>{"bytes"=>run[:stderr].bytesize,"sha256"=>Files.hash(run[:stderr])},
            "finishedAt"=>Time.now.utc.iso8601(6)}))
          raise Error, run[:error] if run[:error]
          unless run[:status].success?
            native_error = begin
              parsed = Files.parse(run[:stderr])
              parsed.is_a?(Hash) && /\A[A-Z0-9_]{1,120}\z/.match?(parsed["error"].to_s) ? parsed["error"] : nil
            rescue Error
              nil
            end
            raise Error, native_error || "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_RECEIVING_FAILED"
          end
          Files.need(self.class.runtime_binding(@runtime["directory"],@runtime["python"],@runtime["node"]) == @runtime,
            "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_RUNTIME_CHANGED")
          NativeDatasetDelivery.check_receipt(Files.parse(run[:stdout],decimals: true),
            room: @room,manifest_sha256: @request["nativeManifestSha256"])
          same_request!
          Files.once(receipt_path,run[:stdout])
        end
        raw = Files.read(receipt_path,16_777_216)
        receipt = Files.parse(raw,decimals: true)
        output_names,archive_names = NativeDatasetDelivery.check_receipt(receipt,
          room: @room,manifest_sha256: @request["nativeManifestSha256"])
        native = receipt.fetch("native")
        target = Files.directory(File.join(@directory,"received"))
        files = []
        (output_names+archive_names).each do |name|
          raise Error, "RUBY_NATIVE_CANCELLED" if cancel&.cancelled?
          original = native["outputs"][name] || native["archives"][name]
          descriptor = {"name"=>name,"bytes"=>original["bytes"],"sha256"=>original["sha256"]}
          copy_original(target,name,descriptor)
          files << descriptor
        end
        dictionary = files.find { |item| item["name"] == "semantics.json" }
        semantics = if dictionary
          DatasetDelivery.snapshot_file(File.join(target,"semantics.json"),dictionary) do |stream|
            Files.parse(stream.read,decimals: true)
          end
        end
        source = {"schema"=>NativeDatasetDelivery::SOURCE_SCHEMA,"sourceFormat"=>"SF100_SCAN",
          "sourceKey"=>@request["sourceKey"],"datasetId"=>@request["datasetId"],"originalRoom"=>@room,
          "sourceId"=>receipt["sourceId"],"manifestSha256"=>receipt["manifestSha256"],
          "sourceBindingSha256"=>receipt["sourceBindingSha256"],
          "datasetName"=>native["originalNativeScan"]["name"],"columns"=>receipt["columns"],
          "providerIdentity"=>NativeDatasetDelivery.provider_identity(semantics),"semanticsFile"=>dictionary}
        metadata = {"selection.json"=>@request_bytes,"native-receiving.json"=>raw,"source.json"=>Files.json(source)}
        metadata.each do |name,bytes|
          NativeDatasetDelivery.check_descriptor(name,{"bytes"=>bytes.bytesize,"sha256"=>Files.hash(bytes)})
          Files.once(File.join(target,name),bytes)
          files << {"name"=>name,"bytes"=>bytes.bytesize,"sha256"=>Files.hash(bytes)}
        end
        scan = native.fetch("originalNativeScan")
        manifest = {"schema"=>NativeDatasetDelivery::SCHEMA,"sourceFormat"=>"SF100_SCAN",
          "sourceKey"=>@request["sourceKey"],"datasetId"=>@request["datasetId"],
          "sourceSha256"=>receipt["sourceId"],"nativeManifestSha256"=>receipt["manifestSha256"],
          "sourceBindingSha256"=>receipt["sourceBindingSha256"],"nativeReceiptSha256"=>Files.hash(raw),
          "sourceRecordSha256"=>Files.hash(metadata["source.json"]),"selectionSha256"=>@request_sha256,
          "snapshot"=>scan["snapshot"],"rowCount"=>scan["count"],"fields"=>scan["fields"],"files"=>files}
        bytes = Files.json(manifest)
        same_request!
        Files.once(File.join(target,DatasetDelivery::MANIFEST),bytes)
        delivery = DatasetDelivery.open(target,expected_manifest_sha256: Files.hash(bytes))
        completion = {"schema"=>RESULT_SCHEMA,"requestSha256"=>@request_sha256,
          "datasetId"=>@request["datasetId"],"sourceKey"=>@request["sourceKey"],
          "sourceId"=>receipt["sourceId"],"nativeReceiptSha256"=>Files.hash(raw),
          "directory"=>target,"manifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256}
        Files.once(File.join(@directory,"received.json"),Files.json(completion))
        self.class.received(directory: @directory)
      end
    end

    private
    def initialize_retained(root, request, bytes)
      runtime = request["runtime"]
      Files.need(request["room"].is_a?(String) && File.expand_path(request["room"]) == request["room"] &&
        runtime.is_a?(Hash) && runtime["files"].is_a?(Array) &&
        %w[directory python node].all? { |key| runtime[key].is_a?(String) &&
          File.expand_path(runtime[key]) == runtime[key] }, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_RUNTIME_SELECTION_INVALID")
      @directory,@request,@request_bytes = root,request,bytes.dup.freeze
      @room,@runtime,@request_sha256 = request["room"],runtime,Files.hash(bytes).freeze
      DatasetDelivery.freeze_value(@request)
      Files.directory(File.join(root,"attempts"),create: true)
      Files.directory(File.join(root,"received"),create: true)
    end

    def copy_original(target, name, expected)
      parent = DatasetDelivery.parent_directory(target,name,create: true)
      destination = File.join(parent,File.basename(name))
      if File.exist?(destination) || File.symlink?(destination)
        DatasetDelivery.snapshot_file(destination,expected) { |_stream| }
        return
      end
      # The same descriptor is fully verified before any bytes enter the packet.
      # Atomic create-only publication lets an interrupted transfer resume.
      DatasetDelivery.parent_directory(@room,name)
      temp = Tempfile.new([".native-dataset-", ".pending"],parent)
      begin
        temp.binmode
        DatasetDelivery.snapshot_file(File.join(@room,name),expected) do |source|
          while (chunk = source.read(1_048_576))
            written = 0
            while written < chunk.bytesize
              count = temp.write(chunk.byteslice(written,chunk.bytesize-written))
              Files.need(count && count > 0, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COPY_FAILED")
              written += count
            end
          end
        end
        temp.flush
        temp.fsync
        temp.close
        begin
          File.link(temp.path,destination)
          Files.sync(parent)
        rescue Errno::EEXIST
          DatasetDelivery.snapshot_file(destination,expected) { |_stream| }
        end
      ensure
        temp.close!
      end
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true
# MIT. Complete dataset revision import into the customer's original Rails database.
require "active_record"
require "active_support/time"
require "set"
require "date"
require "time"
require "csv"
require_relative "dataset_delivery"

module Starforge
  class RailsDataset
    SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.rails-dataset-import.v1"
    TYPES = %w[string integer decimal boolean date datetime].freeze

    class ImportError < StandardError
      attr_reader :code, :details
      def initialize(code, **details)
        @code, @details = code, details
        super([code, details.map { |key,value| "#{key}=#{value.inspect}" }.join(" ")].reject(&:empty?).join(": "))
      end
    end

    def self.need(condition, code, **details)
      raise ImportError.new(code, **details) unless condition
    end

    # Tagged values preserve native integers, decimal precision and dates in
    # complete previews/receipts without JSON's binary-number conversions.
    def self.pack(value)
      case value
      when NilClass then ["null"]
      when TrueClass, FalseClass then ["boolean", value]
      when String then ["string", value]
      when Integer then ["integer", value.to_s]
      when BigDecimal
        need(value.finite?, "DATASET_FINITE_DECIMAL")
        ["decimal", value.to_s("F")]
      when ActiveSupport::TimeWithZone, Time, DateTime then ["datetime", value.to_time.utc.iso8601(9)]
      when Date then ["date", value.iso8601]
      when Array then ["array", value.map { |item| pack(item) }]
      when Hash
        need(value.keys.all? { |key| key.is_a?(String) }, "DATASET_STRING_KEYS")
        ["object", value.keys.sort.map { |key| [key, pack(value.fetch(key))] }]
      else
        raise ImportError.new("DATASET_EXACT_VALUE", type: value.class.name)
      end
    end

    def self.unpack(value)
      type, data = value
      case type
      when "null" then nil
      when "boolean", "string" then data
      when "integer" then Integer(data, 10)
      when "decimal" then BigDecimal(data)
      when "date" then Date.iso8601(data)
      when "datetime" then Time.iso8601(data)
      when "array" then data.map { |item| unpack(item) }
      when "object" then data.to_h { |key,item| [key, unpack(item)] }
      else raise ImportError.new("DATASET_TAGGED_VALUE")
      end
    end

    def self.json(value)
      JSON.generate(value, allow_nan: false, max_nesting: 100)
    end

    def self.exact_json(value)
      json(pack(value))
    end

    def self.sha(value)
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(value.b)
    end

    def self.fingerprint(value)
      sha(exact_json(value))
    end

    def self.copy_json(value)
      JSON.parse(json(value), create_additions: false, allow_nan: false)
    end

    # The complete original source is streamed into a private preview, then
    # streamed again when reviewed or committed. Only key identities stay in RAM.
    class Preview
      attr_reader :binding, :counts, :sha256, :entries_sha256, :row_count
      def initialize(binding)
        @binding = RailsDataset.copy_json(binding)
        @counts = {"inserted"=>0, "updated"=>0, "unchanged"=>0, "removed"=>0,
                   "adopted"=>0, "restored"=>0, "source_changed"=>0}
        @file = Tempfile.new(["starforge-dataset-preview-", ".jsonl"])
        @file.binmode
        @file.unlink
        @digest, @row_count, @sealed, @closed = Digest::SHA256.new, 0, false, false
      end

      def append(entry)
        RailsDataset.need(!@sealed && !@closed, "DATASET_PREVIEW_SEALED")
        raw = RailsDataset.json(entry) + "\n"
        @file.write(raw)
        @digest.update(raw)
        @row_count += 1
        @counts.fetch(entry.fetch("action"))
        @counts[entry.fetch("action")] += 1
        %w[adopted restored source_changed].each { |key| @counts[key] += 1 if entry[key] }
      end

      def seal
        RailsDataset.need(!@closed, "DATASET_PREVIEW_CLOSED")
        unless @sealed
          @file.flush
          @entries_sha256 = @digest.hexdigest
          @sha256 = RailsDataset.fingerprint({"schema"=>SCHEMA, "binding"=>@binding,
            "counts"=>@counts, "row_count"=>@row_count, "entries_sha256"=>@entries_sha256})
          DatasetDelivery.freeze_value(@binding)
          DatasetDelivery.freeze_value(@counts)
          @sha256.freeze
          @entries_sha256.freeze
          @sealed = true
        end
        self
      end

      def each_entry
        return enum_for(__method__) unless block_given?
        RailsDataset.need(@sealed && !@closed, "DATASET_PREVIEW_CLOSED")
        @file.rewind
        seen = Digest::SHA256.new
        @file.each_line do |line|
          seen.update(line)
          yield JSON.parse(line, create_additions: false, allow_nan: false)
        end
        RailsDataset.need(seen.hexdigest == @entries_sha256, "DATASET_PREVIEW_CHANGED")
        self
      end

      def summary
        RailsDataset.need(@sealed && !@closed, "DATASET_PREVIEW_CLOSED")
        {"schema"=>SCHEMA, "binding"=>RailsDataset.copy_json(@binding),
         "preview_sha256"=>@sha256, "entries_sha256"=>@entries_sha256,
         "row_count"=>@row_count, "counts"=>@counts.dup}
      end

      def write_json(io)
        header = RailsDataset.json(summary)
        io.write(header.delete_suffix("}") + ',"rows":[')
        first = true
        each_entry do |row|
          io.write(",") unless first
          io.write(RailsDataset.json(row))
          first = false
        end
        io.write("]}\n")
        self
      end

      def write_csv(io)
        csv = CSV.new(io, force_quotes: true, row_sep: "\n")
        csv << %w[action source_ordinal key target_id adopted restored source_changed before after original_source_json source_row_sha256]
        each_entry do |row|
          csv << [row["action"], row["source_ordinal"], row["key_json"], row["target_id"],
            row["adopted"], row["restored"], row["source_changed"],
            row["before_json"], row["after_json"], row["source_raw_json"], row["source_row_sha256"]]
        end
        csv.flush
        self
      end

      def close
        return if @closed
        @closed = true
        @file.close
      end
    end

    # Explicit field mapping; a missing field can be preserved, while a supplied
    # null can independently be assigned or preserved. Keys always need values.
    class Mapping
      attr_reader :definition, :columns, :key_columns, :sha256, :key_sha256, :removal
      def initialize(definition, model, fields, protected_columns)
        RailsDataset.need(definition.is_a?(Hash), "DATASET_MAPPING")
        @definition = RailsDataset.copy_json(definition)
        RailsDataset.need(@definition["schema"] == "stellar-forge.rails-dataset-mapping.v1",
          "DATASET_MAPPING_SCHEMA")
        @columns, @key_columns = @definition["columns"], @definition["key_columns"]
        RailsDataset.need(@columns.is_a?(Hash) && !@columns.empty? &&
          @key_columns.is_a?(Array) && !@key_columns.empty? &&
          @key_columns.uniq == @key_columns && @key_columns.all? { |key| key.is_a?(String) && @columns.key?(key) },
          "DATASET_MAPPING_KEYS")
        @model = model
        @columns.each do |name,spec|
          RailsDataset.need(name.is_a?(String) && model.columns_hash.key?(name) &&
            !protected_columns.include?(name), "DATASET_TARGET_COLUMN", column: name)
          RailsDataset.need(spec.is_a?(Hash) && fields.include?(spec["field"]) &&
            TYPES.include?(spec["type"]) && %w[assign preserve].include?(spec.fetch("null", "assign")) &&
            %w[error preserve].include?(spec.fetch("missing", "error")) &&
            [true,false].include?(spec.fetch("stringify", false)), "DATASET_FIELD_MAPPING", column: name)
          RailsDataset.need((spec.keys - %w[field type null missing stringify]).empty?,
            "DATASET_MAPPING_OPTION", column: name)
          RailsDataset.need(!@key_columns.include?(name) ||
            (spec.fetch("null", "assign") == "assign" && spec.fetch("missing", "error") == "error"),
            "DATASET_KEY_REQUIRED", column: name)
          verify_type(name, spec["type"])
        end
        @removal = @definition.fetch("removal", {"strategy"=>"retain"})
        RailsDataset.need(@removal.is_a?(Hash) && %w[retain archive].include?(@removal["strategy"]),
          "DATASET_REMOVAL_POLICY")
        allowed_removal = @removal["strategy"] == "archive" ? %w[strategy column active inactive] : %w[strategy]
        RailsDataset.need((@removal.keys - allowed_removal).empty?, "DATASET_REMOVAL_OPTION")
        if @removal["strategy"] == "archive"
          name = @removal["column"]
          RailsDataset.need(name.is_a?(String) && model.columns_hash.key?(name) &&
            model.type_for_attribute(name).type == :boolean &&
            !protected_columns.include?(name) && !@columns.key?(name),
            "DATASET_ARCHIVE_COLUMN")
          RailsDataset.need(@removal.fetch("active", true) == true && @removal.fetch("inactive", false) == false,
            "DATASET_ARCHIVE_BOOLEAN")
        end
        RailsDataset.need((@definition.keys - %w[schema columns key_columns removal]).empty?,
          "DATASET_MAPPING_OPTION")
        DatasetDelivery.freeze_value(@definition)
        DatasetDelivery.freeze_value(@removal)
        @sha256 = RailsDataset.fingerprint(@definition).freeze
        @key_sha256 = RailsDataset.fingerprint({"key_columns"=>@key_columns,
          "columns"=>@columns.slice(*@key_columns)}).freeze
      end

      def verify_type(name, type)
        actual = @model.type_for_attribute(name).type
        accepted = {"string"=>[:string,:text], "integer"=>[:integer],
          "decimal"=>[:decimal], "boolean"=>[:boolean], "date"=>[:date],
          "datetime"=>[:datetime,:timestamp]}
        RailsDataset.need(accepted.fetch(type).include?(actual), "DATASET_COLUMN_TYPE",
          column: name, declared: type, actual: actual)
      end

      def converted(name, spec, value)
        if value.nil?
          RailsDataset.need(@model.columns_hash.fetch(name).null, "DATASET_COLUMN_NULL", column: name)
          return nil
        end
        selected = case spec["type"]
        when "string"
          if value.is_a?(String)
            value
          elsif spec["stringify"] && (value.is_a?(Integer) || value.is_a?(BigDecimal) || value == true || value == false)
            value.is_a?(BigDecimal) ? value.to_s("F") : value.to_s
          else
            raise ImportError.new("DATASET_TEXT_REQUIRED", column: name)
          end
        when "integer"
          if value.is_a?(Integer)
            value
          elsif value.is_a?(BigDecimal) && value.finite? && value.frac.zero?
            value.to_i
          elsif value.is_a?(String) && /\A[+-]?[0-9]+\z/.match?(value)
            Integer(value, 10)
          else
            raise ImportError.new("DATASET_INTEGER_REQUIRED", column: name)
          end
        when "decimal"
          RailsDataset.need(value.is_a?(Integer) || value.is_a?(BigDecimal) ||
            value.is_a?(String) && /\A[+-]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?\z/.match?(value),
            "DATASET_DECIMAL_REQUIRED", column: name)
          parsed = value.is_a?(BigDecimal) ? value : BigDecimal(value.to_s)
          RailsDataset.need(parsed.finite?, "DATASET_FINITE_DECIMAL", column: name)
          parsed
        when "boolean"
          RailsDataset.need(value == true || value == false, "DATASET_BOOLEAN_REQUIRED", column: name)
          value
        when "date"
          RailsDataset.need(value.is_a?(String) && /\A[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\z/.match?(value),
            "DATASET_DATE_REQUIRED", column: name)
          Date.iso8601(value)
        when "datetime"
          RailsDataset.need(value.is_a?(String) &&
            /\A[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T.+(?:Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})\z/.match?(value),
            "DATASET_TIMESTAMP_OFFSET", column: name)
          Time.iso8601(value).utc
        end
        if selected.is_a?(String)
          RailsDataset.need(selected.valid_encoding? && !selected.include?("\0"), "DATASET_TEXT_ENCODING", column: name)
          limit = @model.columns_hash.fetch(name).limit
          RailsDataset.need(limit.nil? || selected.length <= limit, "DATASET_TEXT_LENGTH", column: name)
        end
        if selected.is_a?(BigDecimal)
          column = @model.columns_hash.fetch(name)
          if column.precision && column.scale
            integral_digits = selected.zero? ? 0 : [selected.abs.exponent, 0].max
            RailsDataset.need(integral_digits <= column.precision - column.scale,
              "DATASET_DECIMAL_RANGE", column: name, precision: column.precision, scale: column.scale)
          end
        end
        type = @model.type_for_attribute(name)
        returned = type.deserialize(type.serialize(selected))
        RailsDataset.need(returned == selected, "DATASET_COLUMN_PRECISION", column: name,
          selected: selected.to_s, stored: returned.to_s)
        selected
      rescue ArgumentError, RangeError => error
        raise ImportError.new("DATASET_COLUMN_VALUE", column: name, reason: error.message)
      end

      def values(row)
        RailsDataset.need(row.is_a?(Hash), "DATASET_SOURCE_ROW")
        result = {}
        @columns.each do |name,spec|
          field = spec.fetch("field")
          unless row.key?(field)
            RailsDataset.need(spec.fetch("missing", "error") == "preserve",
              "DATASET_SOURCE_FIELD_MISSING", field: field)
            next
          end
          next if row[field].nil? && spec.fetch("null", "assign") == "preserve"
          result[name] = converted(name, spec, row[field])
        end
        @key_columns.each do |name|
          value = result[name]
          RailsDataset.need(!value.nil? && !(value.is_a?(String) && value.empty?),
            "DATASET_KEY_REQUIRED", column: name)
        end
        result[@removal["column"]] = true if @removal["strategy"] == "archive"
        result
      end

      def key(values)
        selected = @key_columns.to_h { |name| [name, values.fetch(name)] }
        raw = RailsDataset.exact_json(selected)
        [RailsDataset.sha(raw), raw]
      end

      def removed_values
        @removal["strategy"] == "archive" ? {@removal.fetch("column")=>false} : {}
      end

      def target_columns
        (@columns.keys + (@removal["strategy"] == "archive" ? [@removal["column"]] : [])).uniq
      end
    end

    attr_reader :mapping

    # models contains the application's edition, row and entry ActiveRecord
    # classes. stream is its persisted stream record; scope is its authorized
    # tenant relation. Every model must use the very same database connection.
    def initialize(delivery:, scope:, stream:, models:, mapping:)
      self.class.need(delivery.is_a?(DatasetDelivery), "DATASET_ORIGINAL_DELIVERY")
      self.class.need(scope.is_a?(ActiveRecord::Relation) && stream.is_a?(ActiveRecord::Base) &&
        stream.persisted?, "DATASET_NATIVE_SCOPE")
      self.class.need(models.is_a?(Hash) && %i[edition row entry].all? { |key|
        models[key].is_a?(Class) && models[key] < ActiveRecord::Base }, "DATASET_NATIVE_MODELS")
      @delivery, @scope, @stream = delivery, scope.reorder(nil), stream
      @model, @models = @scope.klass, models.slice(:edition, :row, :entry).freeze
      self.class.need(@scope.limit_value.nil? && @scope.offset_value.nil? &&
        @scope.group_values.empty?, "DATASET_COMPLETE_TARGET_SCOPE")
      pool = @stream.class.connection_pool
      self.class.need(([@model] + @models.values).all? { |model| model.connection_pool.equal?(pool) },
        "DATASET_ONE_DATABASE")
      self.class.need(@model.primary_key.is_a?(String), "DATASET_TARGET_PRIMARY_KEY")
      @pk = @model.primary_key
      @scope_values = @scope.scope_for_create.stringify_keys
      protected_columns = ([@pk, @model.inheritance_column, "created_at", "updated_at", "lock_version"] +
        @scope_values.keys).compact.uniq
      @mapping = Mapping.new(mapping, @model, @delivery.fields, protected_columns)
      @scope_sha = self.class.fingerprint({"model"=>@model.name, "sql"=>@scope.to_sql,
        "creation_values"=>@scope_values})
      @membership = self.class.copy_json(@delivery.membership)
      self.class.need(@membership.is_a?(Hash) &&
        @membership["query_sha256"].is_a?(String) &&
        /\A[a-f0-9]{64}\z/.match?(@membership["query_sha256"]) &&
        @membership["projected_fields"] == @delivery.fields, "DATASET_QUERY_MEMBERSHIP")
      DatasetDelivery.freeze_value(@membership)
      @membership_sha = self.class.fingerprint(@membership)
      @schema_sha = self.class.fingerprint(@mapping.target_columns.sort.map do |name|
        column = @model.columns_hash.fetch(name)
        {"name"=>name, "type"=>column.type.to_s, "sql_type"=>column.sql_type,
         "limit"=>column.limit, "precision"=>column.precision, "scale"=>column.scale, "null"=>column.null}
      end)
      verify_unique_key!
    end

    def verify_unique_key!
      allowed = (@mapping.key_columns + @scope_values.keys).uniq
      indexes = @model.connection.indexes(@model.table_name)
      eligible = indexes.any? do |index|
        columns = index.columns
        index.unique && columns.is_a?(Array) &&
          (@mapping.key_columns - columns).empty? && (columns - allowed).empty? &&
          (!index.respond_to?(:where) || index.where.nil? || index.where.empty?)
      end
      self.class.need(eligible, "DATASET_UNIQUE_TARGET_KEY",
        columns: @mapping.key_columns, scope_columns: @scope_values.keys)
    end

    def validate_stream!
      {"target_model"=>@model.name, "scope_sha256"=>@scope_sha,
       "key_mapping_sha256"=>@mapping.key_sha256, "membership_sha256"=>@membership_sha}.each do |key,expected|
        actual = @stream.public_send(key)
        self.class.need(actual.nil? || actual == expected, "DATASET_STREAM_BINDING", field: key)
      end
      self.class.need(@stream.revision.is_a?(Integer) && @stream.revision >= 0, "DATASET_STREAM_REVISION")
    end

    def source_binding
      {"manifest_sha256"=>@delivery.manifest_sha256, "source_sha256"=>@delivery.source_sha256,
       "snapshot"=>self.class.pack(@delivery.snapshot), "row_count"=>@delivery.row_count,
       "fields"=>@delivery.fields, "membership"=>@membership}
    end

    def prior_receipt
      return nil if @stream.latest_edition_id.nil?
      edition = @models[:edition].find_by(id: @stream.latest_edition_id, dataset_stream_id: @stream.id)
      self.class.need(edition, "DATASET_PRIOR_EDITION_MISSING")
      verified_receipt(edition)
      self.class.need(edition.revision == @stream.revision, "DATASET_PRIOR_REVISION_CHANGED")
      edition.receipt_sha256
    end

    def binding
      validate_stream!
      {"stream_id"=>@stream.id.to_s, "target_model"=>@model.name, "scope_sha256"=>@scope_sha,
       "source"=>source_binding, "mapping"=>@mapping.definition, "mapping_sha256"=>@mapping.sha256,
       "schema_sha256"=>@schema_sha, "prior_revision"=>@stream.revision,
       "prior_edition_id"=>@stream.latest_edition_id&.to_s, "prior_receipt_sha256"=>prior_receipt}
    end

    def preview
      result = nil
      @stream.with_lock { result = build_preview }
      result
    end

    def key_tuple(record)
      @mapping.key_columns.to_h { |name| [name, record.public_send(name)] }
    end

    def target_values(record, columns)
      return {} unless record
      columns.to_h { |name| [name, record.public_send(name)] }
    end

    def target_fingerprint(record, columns)
      values = {"present"=>!record.nil?, "id"=>record&.public_send(@pk)&.to_s,
        "values"=>target_values(record, columns)}
      values["lock_version"] = record.lock_version if record && record.has_attribute?("lock_version")
      self.class.fingerprint(values)
    end

    def matching_targets(batch)
      table = @model.arel_table
      predicates = batch.map do |row|
